questions.questionText: Why isn't Cat Ba Island chosen in the itineraries of the majority of travellers coming to Viet Nam?
questions.passageText:
Read the passage and answer the following questions.

Being overshadowed by Ha Long Bay to the north, Cat Ba Island is often left out of the itineraries of the majority of travellers coming to Viet Nam. Nevertheless, Cat Ba Island is one of the most attractive destinations in Viet Nam. 

The massive island of Cat Ba is a fantastic destination for ecotourism and adventure activities in Northern Viet Nam. Cat Ba National Park, which was established on 31st March 1986, is one of the most ecologically diverse national parks in Viet Nam. The park possesses seven different ecosystems, both underwater and inland. It is home to thirty-two types of mammals, along with seventy bird species, and more than a thousand species of plants, hundreds of which can be used as medicines. 

There are several different hiking and trekking routes through rugged and forested mountains within Cat Ba National Park. These routes are also categorized according to different types of trekking, so travellers don't have to be worried if they don't have a high level of physical fitness. In addition, travellers can take a side visit to explore the exquisite Trung Trang cave or discover the traditional village of Viet Hai.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because it is not a good destination for tourism.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because it is too far from Ha Long Bay.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because there is too much rain there.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because it is overshadowed by Ha Long Bay.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions. 

The phrase "healthy lifestyle" is a definition of how you should live if you want to get the healthiest body you can - one that both looks good and feels good. You know the obvious behaviors that describe someone who is healthy and takes care of themselves. A healthy person doesn’t smoke, eats healthy foods with plenty of fruits, vegetables and fiber and, of course, exercises regularly. A healthy person also knows how to manage stress, gets good quality sleep each night, doesn’t drink too much, doesn’t sit too much, does everything in moderation all the time. When you look at everything that could possibly make a healthy lifestyle, you can see just how hard all of those things are in our current world.

There is no such thing as a "bad" food, but there are some foods you should try not to have regularly. Fast food refers to food that can be prepared and served quickly. It is popular as the food is inexpensive, convenient, and tastes good. Because fast food is high in sodium, trans-fat, and cholesterol, it isn't something you should eat often.

The good news is that you don't have to change everything at the same time. In fact, the trick to healthy living is making small changes - taking more steps each day, adding fruit to your cereal, having an extra glass of water, or saying no to that second helping of buttery mashed potatoes. One thing you can do right now to make your lifestyle healthier is to move more.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ways to live a healthy life

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the text?
questions.passageText:
Read the text and choose the best answer.

Shopping centers become a favorite place for people in leisure time due to various reasons. One of the main factors is the convenience they offer. These centers provide easy access to numerous shops, and help customers to explore different items all in one place. Additionally, the diverse display of goods, from clothing to electronics, in well-organized shops is a definite attraction.

In most shopping centers, it is impossible to bargain. The prices of items are usually fixed and displayed with price tags. However, there are occasional sales or discounts that you can take advantage of to get a better deal on certain items. Advertisements play a significant role in informing customers about the products on sale and encouraging them to make purchases. Therefore, people often display them prominently to attract the attention of shoppers.

However, the appearance of shopping centers makes many people, especially young people, become addicted to shopping. Some individuals become shopaholics and can't stop their shopping habit excessively. They may even make a regular schedule to visit the shopping centers, sometimes leading to complaints about overspending.

questions.passageText:

Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world. It is also the highest trash pile in the world. About 400 people try to reach the top every year. Having many climbers means having a lot of trash.

It is very dangerous to climb Mount Everest. The air is very thin and cold. Most people carry bottles of oxygen because they can die without it. When the oxygen bottles are empty, people throw them on the ground. They don’t have the energy to take the trash away. They only have enough energy to go down the mountain safely.

Trash is a terrible problem. Since people first began to climb Mount Everest, they have left 50,000 kilos of trash on the mountain. Several groups have climbed the mountain just to pick up the trash. When people plan to climb the mountain, they should plan to take away their trash.

questions.questionText: What is true about Mercury but not true about the moon or Mars?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

There is one planet that still fascinates and teases scientists mainly because it doesn’t have an atmosphere to obscure observation, yet it is not big enough for sufficiently accurate telescopic observation. The fact that it is also very close to the sun also makes it difficult for astronomers.

However, space telescopes have told us a lot more about Mercury. It is rather similar to Earth’s moon and to Mars. There are mountainous areas dotted with craters and large valleys which are uncratered. The moon’s valleys have fewer cracks and ridges are smoother. Mercury’s valleys are filled with volcanic rocks, similar to on the moon, yet there is no evidence of volcanoes, even extinct ones, on Mercury, as there is on the both Mars and the moon, and of course here on Earth.

So, scientists presume the valleys on Mercury were caused by different things, that is to say not by volcanoes, but by very large meteorites, which also caused the cracks in the terrain and left the ridges rough and uneven. More and better photos of Mercury are needed to prove what are at present at best only hypotheses.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The valleys are filled with volcanic rocks.

questions.explanation:
Các thung lũng của sao Thủy được lấp đầy bằng đá núi lửa, tương tự như trên mặt trăng. Tuy nhiên, không có bằng chứng nào về núi lửa, kể cả những núi lửa đã tắt trên sao Thủy, trong khi trên cả sao Hỏa và mặt trăng, và tất nhiên là cả trên Trái Đất đều có (núi lửa).

=> Mặt trăng và sao Hỏa có núi lửa còn sao Thủy không có (chỉ có đá núi lửa). 

=> Thông tin đúng về sao Thủy nhưng không đúng về mặt trăng và sao Hỏa là không có núi lửa.

The best way to improve the four skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing is to practice regularly. questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

English is one of the most popular languages in the world. It comes second in the number of speakers after Chinese. In Vietnam, more and more people are studying English and they consider it a key to success. However, not everyone knows how to learn English effectively. 

The best way to improve the four skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing is to practice regularly. You should make use of every opportunity to speak English with friends in class or at English speaking clubs or ourselves in front of the mirror. Learning by heart all the words does not help much if you do not read a lot because you will easily forget what you have learnt. Reading books, listening to the radio and watching films are better ways to memorize words. Besides, English learners should not be so shy because making mistakes is unavoidable in learning foreign languages. Practicing speaking a lot is a good way to correct your mistakes.

questions.passageText:

One of the most urgent environmental problems in the world today is the shortage of clean water. Having clean drinking water is a basic human right. However, acid rain, industrial pollution and garbage have made many sources of water undrinkable. Lakes, reservoirs and even entire seas have become vast pools of poison. Lake Baikal in Russia is one of the largest lakes in the world. It contains a rich variety of animals and plants, including 1,300 rare species that do not exist anywhere else in the world. Yet, they are being destroyed by the massive volumes of industrial effluent which pour into the lake every day. Even though laws have been made, the governments do not have the power to enforce them. Most industries simply ignore the regulations. The Mediterranean Sea occupies 1% of the world's water surface, but it is the dumping ground for 50% of all marine pollution. Almost 16 countries regularly dump industrial waste a few miles offshore. 

Clean water is now scarce, and we are at last beginning to respect this precious resource. We should do something now.

Women's equality is an important issue that has been discussed for many years. Women have historically faced disadvantages in areas like education and the workplace. While progress has been made, there is still a lot of work to do.

One major challenge that women face is workplace discrimination. Women are often paid less than men for the same job and are less likely to be promoted to leadership positions. This can limit their career opportunities and hold them back.

Access to education is another area where women have historically been disadvantaged. In some places, girls are not encouraged to go to school or pursue academic and professional goals, which limits their opportunities for personal and financial success.

Gender-based violence is also a problem that women face. This can cause long-term physical and emotional problems for women, which affects their quality of life.

To achieve gender equality, it's important to promote women's leadership, ensure equal access to education and economic opportunities, and address gender-based violence. This is necessary for creating a fair and just society where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed.

Gender equality is an important issue that needs to be addressed to create a better and more reasonable world for all people.

questions.questionText: What do people do for Earth Hour?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Earth Hour is organised by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) and it’s a big event usually at the end of March every year. On this evening, people ‘go dark’ – that is, switch off lights in their homes, schools and businesses all at the same time for one hour. Earth Hour started in Australia in 2007, when 2.2 million people in Sydney turned off all unnecessary lights for an hour. Since then, it has grown into an international event, and many countries around the world have taken part. Famous buildings that have gone dark for Earth Hour include the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge, the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur, the Houses of Parliament and Buckingham Palace in London, the Eiffel Tower in Paris, the Forbidden City in Beijing and New York’s Empire State Building. The idea is to raise awareness of environmental issues and call for action to protect nature, so that people enjoy healthy, happy and sustainable lives now and in the future. It’s true that switching off the lights for just one hour saves only a small amount of power. But this is only the beginning. On one level, joining in Earth Hour makes people think about the problem of climate change and what we can do in everyday life to protect nature. The logo of Earth Hour is ‘60+’. The number 60 is for the 60 minutes of Earth Hour, and the plus invites people to keep on taking action even after Earth Hour is finished. In fact, people who join in Earth Hour say that taking part makes them want to do more for the environment. The climate activist Greta Thunberg says that ‘Earth Hour is every hour of every day.’

choices.label: B
choices.text: Watch TV to participate in the campaign.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Switch on the lights at famous buildings.

=> Mọi người hưởng ứng Giờ Trái đất bằng cách tắt các đèn không cần thiết.

Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Earth Hour is organised by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) and it’s a big event usually at the end of March every year. On this evening, people ‘go dark’ – that is, switch off lights in their homes, schools and businesses all at the same time for one hour. Earth Hour started in Australia in 2007, when 2.2 million people in Sydney turned off all unnecessary lights for an hour. Since then, it has grown into an international event, and many countries around the world have taken part. Famous buildings that have gone dark for Earth Hour include the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge, the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur, the Houses of Parliament and Buckingham Palace in London, the Eiffel Tower in Paris, the Forbidden City in Beijing and New York’s Empire State Building. The idea is to raise awareness of environmental issues and call for action to protect nature, so that people enjoy healthy, happy and sustainable lives now and in the future. It’s true that switching off the lights for just one hour saves only a small amount of power. But this is only the beginning. On one level, joining in Earth Hour makes people think about the problem of climate change and what we can do in everyday life to protect nature. The logo of Earth Hour is ‘60+’. The number 60 is for the 60 minutes of Earth Hour, and the plus invites people to keep on taking action even after Earth Hour is finished. In fact, people who join in Earth Hour say that taking part makes them want to do more for the environment. The climate activist Greta Thunberg says that ‘Earth Hour is every hour of every day.’
questions.explanation:
Giờ Trái đất bắt đầu ở Úc vào năm 2007, khi 2,2 triệu người ở Sydney tắt tất cả các đèn không cần thiết trong một giờ. Kể từ đó, nó đã phát triển thành một sự kiện quốc tế và được nhiều quốc gia trên thế giới tham gia.

=> Từ "it" trong bài thay thế cho "Earth Hour".

questions.questionText: Bamboo is a type of _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Bamboo is an amazing plant. Do you know it is actually grass? In fact, giant bamboo is the largest member of the grass family. Some types can grow an incredible 90 centimetres in just one day. Some bamboo plants can grow to over 30 metres tall, which is as tall as a gum tree.

You probably know that bamboo is the favourite food of pandas, but chimpanzees, gorillas and elephants eat it too. Bamboo is also extremely useful to people. It is a very valuable construction material because it is so strong. In fact, whole houses can be built from bamboo. In some parts of the world, bamboo is used as scaffolding (the frame used to support building work).

The range of things that can be made from bamboo is huge. Furniture, cooking utensils, and musical instruments can all be made from bamboo. It can even be used to make bicycle frames and boats. Bamboo fibres can be used to produce a soft, cotton-like material for T-shirts and underwear. They also use bamboo fibres to make paper.
questions.hint: Hãy đọc kỹ câu thứ hai trong đoạn văn đầu tiên để tìm câu trả lời cho câu hỏi này.
questions.explanation: Phân tích: Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định tre thuộc loại thực vật nào. Bài đọc cung cấp thông tin rõ ràng ở ngay đoạn đầu tiên: [[Do you know it is actually grass?]] (Bạn có biết nó thực chất là cỏ không?). Dựa vào dẫn chứng này, ta có thể kết luận tre là một loại cỏ.

answerFeedbacks.1477606: Bài đọc khẳng định rõ "Do you know it is actually grass?" (Bạn có biết nó thực chất là cỏ không?).
answerFeedbacks.1477607: Thông tin này trái ngược với bài đọc vì bài đọc phân loại tre là một loại cỏ.

questions.questionText: According to the passage, all of the following can be made from bamboo EXCEPT _____.

Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Bamboo is an amazing plant. Do you know it is actually grass? In fact, giant bamboo is the largest member of the grass family. Some types can grow an incredible 90 centimetres in just one day. Some bamboo plants can grow to over 30 metres tall, which is as tall as a gum tree.

questions.hint: Hãy đọc kỹ đoạn văn cuối cùng, nơi tác giả liệt kê hàng loạt sản phẩm làm từ tre. Câu hỏi yêu cầu bạn tìm ra thứ KHÔNG được nhắc đến trong bài.
questions.explanation: Phân tích: Câu hỏi yêu cầu tìm ra vật dụng KHÔNG được làm từ tre theo thông tin trong bài đọc. Để trả lời, ta cần rà soát các thông tin được liệt kê trong bài. Đoạn 3 có nêu: [[Furniture, cooking utensils, and musical instruments can all be made from bamboo.]] (Đồ nội thất, dụng cụ nấu ăn và nhạc cụ đều có thể được làm từ tre.). Thông tin này giúp loại bỏ phương án 1 và 3. Đoạn 2 có viết: [[It is a very valuable construction material...]] (Nó là một vật liệu xây dựng rất có giá trị...). Thông tin này giúp loại bỏ phương án 2. Bài đọc có nhắc đến [[bicycle frames]] (khung xe đạp) nhưng không hề đề cập đến khung xe hơi (car frames). Vì vậy, phương án 4 là đáp án chính xác.

answerFeedbacks.1477613: Phương án này sai vì bài đọc có đề cập đến việc tre được dùng để làm nhạc cụ trong câu "Furniture, cooking utensils, and musical instruments can all be made from bamboo."
answerFeedbacks.1477614: Phương án này sai vì bài đọc có khẳng định tre là một vật liệu xây dựng giá trị trong câu "It is a very valuable construction material because it is so strong."
answerFeedbacks.1477615: Phương án này sai vì bài đọc có đề cập đến việc tre được dùng để làm dụng cụ nấu ăn trong câu "Furniture, cooking utensils, and musical instruments can all be made from bamboo."
answerFeedbacks.1477616: Đây là đáp án đúng vì bài đọc không hề đề cập đến việc tre được dùng để làm khung xe hơi, mà chỉ nhắc đến khung xe đạp.

Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Bamboo is an amazing plant. Do you know it is actually grass? In fact, giant bamboo is the largest member of the grass family. Some types can grow an incredible 90 centimetres in just one day. Some bamboo plants can grow to over 30 metres tall, which is as tall as a gum tree.

Bamboo fibres can be used to produce a soft, cotton-like material for T-shirts and underwear. They also use bamboo fibres to make paper.

choices.label: A
choices.text: People never use bamboo fibres to make paper.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A bamboo plant can't be over 30 metres tall.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Bamboo can be used to build a house.

questions.hint: Hãy đọc lướt bài đọc để tìm các từ khóa có trong mỗi phương án trả lời (ví dụ: 'paper', 'pandas', '30 metres', 'house'). Sau đó, đọc kỹ câu chứa từ khóa đó để xác định xem phương án đưa ra là đúng hay sai so với thông tin trong bài.
questions.explanation:
Phân tích: Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định phát biểu nào là đúng theo nội dung bài đọc.

Ta cần xét từng phương án:

  • Phương án 1 sai vì câu cuối bài đọc có viết: [[They also use bamboo fibres to make paper.]] (Họ cũng dùng sợi tre để làm giấy.).
  • Phương án 2 sai vì bài đọc có nêu: [[...but chimpanzees, gorillas and elephants eat it too.]] (...nhưng tinh tinh, khỉ đột và voi cũng ăn nó.).
  • Phương án 3 sai vì đoạn 1 có thông tin: [[Some bamboo plants can grow to over 30 metres tall...]] (Một số cây tre có thể cao tới hơn 30 mét...).
  • Phương án 4 là đáp án đúng vì bài đọc có thông tin: [[In fact, whole houses can be built from bamboo.]] (Thực tế, cả một ngôi nhà có thể được xây dựng từ tre.).

answerFeedbacks.1477617: Đây là thông tin sai vì bài đọc khẳng định rằng người ta có sử dụng sợi tre để làm giấy.
answerFeedbacks.1477618: Đây là thông tin sai vì bài đọc liệt kê thêm tinh tinh, khỉ đột và voi cũng ăn tre.
answerFeedbacks.1477619: Đây là thông tin sai vì bài đọc nêu rõ rằng một số cây tre có thể cao hơn 30 mét.
answerFeedbacks.1477620: Đây là thông tin đúng, được xác nhận bởi câu "In fact, whole houses can be built from bamboo." trong bài đọc.

questions.questionText: What is the main purpose of this passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Bamboo is an amazing plant. Do you know it is actually grass? In fact, giant bamboo is the largest member of the grass family. Some types can grow an incredible 90 centimetres in just one day. Some bamboo plants can grow to over 30 metres tall, which is as tall as a gum tree.

You probably know that bamboo is the favourite food of pandas, but chimpanzees, gorillas and elephants eat it too. Bamboo is also extremely useful to people. In some parts of the world, bamboo is used as scaffolding (the frame used to support building work).

The range of things that can be made from bamboo is huge. Furniture, cooking utensils, and musical instruments can all be made from bamboo. It can even be used to make bicycle frames and boats. Bamboo fibres can be used to produce a soft, cotton-like material for T-shirts and underwear. They also use bamboo fibres to make paper.

choices.label: A
choices.text: To give interesting facts about bamboo and its uses

choices.label: B
choices.text: To encourage people to save bamboo trees

choices.label: C
choices.text: To advise people to use bamboo more often

questions.hint: Để xác định mục đích chính, hãy đọc lướt lại toàn bộ bài đọc và tự hỏi: Tác giả chủ yếu viết về điều gì? Bài đọc có đưa ra lời khuyên hay kêu gọi hành động không, hay chỉ đơn thuần cung cấp thông tin?
questions.explanation:
Phân tích: Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định mục đích chính của bài đọc. Toàn bộ bài đọc được viết nhằm cung cấp cho người đọc các thông tin thú vị về cây tre. Đoạn 1 giới thiệu những sự thật chung về tre, ví dụ: [[Do you know it is actually grass?]] (Bạn có biết nó thực chất là cỏ không?) và tốc độ phát triển của nó [[Some types can grow an incredible 90 centimetres in just one day.]] (Một số loại có thể phát triển đáng kinh ngạc 90 cm chỉ trong một ngày.). Các đoạn sau tập trung liệt kê rất nhiều công dụng của tre đối với con người, từ [[valuable construction material]] (vật liệu xây dựng có giá trị) đến làm đồ nội thất, nhạc cụ, quần áo và giấy. Vì vậy, mục đích chính của bài là cung cấp các sự thật thú vị và công dụng của tre, tương ứng với phương án 1.

Phương án 3 có thể gây nhầm lẫn. Mặc dù bài đọc nêu ra nhiều lợi ích của tre, nhưng tác giả chỉ đang liệt kê thông tin một cách khách quan chứ không dùng ngôn ngữ mang tính khuyên bảo hay kêu gọi mọi người nên sử dụng tre thường xuyên hơn. Do đó, mục đích "khuyên" (advise) là không chính xác.

answerFeedbacks.1477621: Đáp án này là đúng vì bài đọc trình bày nhiều thông tin thực tế về cây tre (là một loại cỏ, tốc độ phát triển) và liệt kê hàng loạt công dụng của nó (xây dựng, làm đồ gia dụng, quần áo, giấy).
answerFeedbacks.1477622: Phương án này sai vì bài đọc không hề đề cập đến việc cây tre đang gặp nguy hiểm hay cần được bảo tồn (Not Given).
answerFeedbacks.1477623: Phương án này sai vì giọng văn của tác giả mang tính thông tin, miêu tả chứ không phải khuyên nhủ hay thuyết phục người đọc.
answerFeedbacks.1477624: Phương án này sai vì bài đọc chỉ nhắc đến "In some parts of the world" mà không hề cung cấp thông tin cụ thể về các khu vực trồng tre chủ yếu (Not Given).

questions.questionText: What is the main topic of the forum discussion?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

TEENTECH Forum

Thomson@2005: I always read about teens and how much time they spend on their electronic devices. Is it a good idea for teens to have a lot of electronic devices? What do you think?

Dan@14: Of course it is! Having a device like a smartphone is a great way for me to contact friends and family members – especially the ones I don’t see very often. I share photos and send them text messages on a messaging app all the time. I also use my laptop and my tablet to do research and improve my computer skills.

Harrison@008: Electronic devices can have some negative effects on teens. I had a tablet, a smartphone and a games console. I spent too much time playing video games and going on social media. My parents said it would reduce my attention span and make me lack social skills. My doctor told me I was gaining weight, too. Now, I just have a smartphone and I only use it after I finish my homework. I’m glad I stopped wasting so much time on electronic devices.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Several benefits of social media for teenagers

choices.label: B
choices.text: Some effects of electronic devices on teens

choices.label: C
choices.text: Different ways to contact friends and family members

choices.label: D
choices.text: Different ways to improve computer skills

questions.explanation:
Nội dung của từng đoạn trong bài:

- Đoạn 1: Một người dùng đặt câu hỏi trên một diễn đàn về việc thanh thiếu niên có nên dùng thiết bị điện tử nhiều hay không.

questions.questionText: Why does Dan@14 believe it's good for teens to have electronic devices?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

TEENTECH Forum

Thomson@2005: I always read about teens and how much time they spend on their electronic devices. Is it a good idea for teens to have a lot of electronic devices? What do you think?

Dan@14: Of course it is! Having a device like a smartphone is a great way for me to contact friends and family members – especially the ones I don’t see very often. I share photos and send them text messages on a messaging app all the time. I also use my laptop and my tablet to do research and improve my computer skills.

Harrison@008: Electronic devices can have some negative effects on teens. I had a tablet, a smartphone and a games console. I spent too much time playing video games and going on social media. My parents said it would reduce my attention span and make me lack social skills. My doctor told me I was gaining weight, too. Now, I just have a smartphone and I only use it after I finish my homework. I’m glad I stopped wasting so much time on electronic devices.

questions.questionText: What is the problem in New York?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question below.

New York is called “the Big Apple”. Maybe it is not exactly like an apple, it’s certainly very big. There are too many people, that’s the problem. The streets are always full of cars and trucks; you can never find a place to park.

Travelling around is never easy in the city. If you have enough money, you can take a taxi. New York cabs are yellow. They look all the same. But the drivers are very different. Some were born and raised in New York, but many are newcomers to the United States.

A few drive slowly, but most go very fast. Cab driving is a difficult job. It can be dangerous, too. Thieves often try to steal the drivers’ money. Drivers sometimes get hurt.

If you don’t want to take a taxi, you can go by bus or you can take a subway. The subway is quick and it’s cheap, but parts of it are old and dirty. Lights don’t always work and there are often fires on the track. On some subway lines, there are new, clean, silver trains. But you can’t see the color of the old trains easily. There is too much dirt and too much graffiti, inside and outside.
questions.explanation:
Có quá nhiều người (ở New York), đó là vấn đề.

=> Vấn đề ở New York là nó quá đông đúc.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the reading passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

British English and American English are two variations of the English language that share many similarities, but also some notable differences in pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar.

The pronunciation of American English is one of the biggest differences. One of the most noticeable differences is the pronunciation of R. The British tend to pronounce R in the middle and end of words very softly, but Americans like to stress it. Spelling is another difference. Americans often spell many verbs ending with a -t sound by using -ed as in burnt (BE) and burned (AE). In both of these cases, the -t is pronounced. British prefer to spell -ise with a S but American prefer to spell it as it is pronounced with a Z.

There are even differences in vocabulary. Americans use the word “pants” for “trousers” and “apartment” for “flat”.

Grammar is another area of difference. The British are more likely to use formal speech, such as “shall”, while Americans prefer the more informal version, “will”. You may hear the British say “needn’t” but Americans would almost always use “don’t need to”. In spite of these differences, the vast majority of language points are the same in both variations.

choices.label: A
choices.text: British and American English are identical in all aspects.

choices.label: B
choices.text: British and American English have key differences but many similarities.

choices.label: C
choices.text: There are different ways to pronounce British and American English.

choices.label: D
choices.text: There are different variations of the English language around the world.

questions.hint: Để tìm ý chính của một bài đọc, hãy chú ý đến câu đầu tiên và câu cuối cùng. Thường thì câu đầu tiên sẽ giới thiệu chủ đề và câu cuối cùng sẽ tóm tắt hoặc khẳng định lại quan điểm của tác giả.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định ý chính của cả đoạn văn. Để trả lời, học sinh cần đọc và tổng hợp thông tin từ toàn bộ bài đọc, đặc biệt là câu chủ đề (thường ở đầu đoạn) và câu kết luận (thường ở cuối đoạn) để nắm được nội dung bao quát nhất.

Phân tích: Câu đầu tiên của đoạn văn giới thiệu rằng tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ [[share many similarities, but also some notable differences]] (có nhiều điểm tương đồng, nhưng cũng có một số khác biệt đáng chú ý). Các đoạn sau đó liệt kê những khác biệt này về phát âm, chính tả, từ vựng và ngữ pháp.

Tuy nhiên, câu cuối cùng nhấn mạnh rằng [[In spite of these differences, the vast majority of language points are the same in both variations]] (Bất chấp những khác biệt này, phần lớn các điểm ngôn ngữ là giống nhau ở cả hai biến thể).

Như vậy, ý chính của cả bài là tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ vừa có những điểm khác biệt quan trọng, vừa có nhiều điểm chung, tương ứng với phương án 2.

Phương án 3 là một ý đúng nhưng quá hẹp, vì phát âm chỉ là một trong những khác biệt được đề cập. Phương án 1 sai hoàn toàn vì bài văn tập trung vào sự khác biệt. Phương án 4 quá rộng, vì bài văn chỉ so sánh hai biến thể là Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ, không nói về các biến thể khác trên thế giới.

Dịch câu hỏi:

Ý chính của đoạn văn là gì?

✖ Tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ giống hệt nhau về mọi mặt.

✔ Tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ có những điểm khác biệt chính nhưng cũng có nhiều điểm tương đồng.

✖ Có nhiều cách khác nhau để phát âm tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ.

✖ Có nhiều biến thể khác nhau của tiếng Anh trên khắp thế giới.

Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định phương pháp mà tác giả sử dụng để làm rõ các luận điểm. Để trả lời, học sinh cần đọc lướt bài và nhận ra cách tác giả minh họa cho những khác biệt giữa tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ.

Phân tích: Trong bài, để giải thích cho những điểm khác biệt giữa tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ, tác giả đã đưa ra các ví dụ cụ thể.
- Về chính tả: tác giả nêu ví dụ về cách viết của từ [[burnt (BE) and burned (AE)]].
- Về từ vựng: tác giả đưa ra ví dụ [[Americans use the word “pants” for “trousers” and “apartment” for “flat”]].
- Về ngữ pháp: tác giả nêu ví dụ về việc người Anh dùng [[shall]] còn người Mỹ dùng [[will]], hoặc người Anh dùng [[needn’t]] còn người Mỹ dùng [[don’t need to]].

Tất cả những dẫn chứng trên đều là các ví dụ. Do đó, phương án 3 là đáp án đúng. Các phương án còn lại không đúng vì tác giả không sử dụng số, ký hiệu hay lời trích dẫn của người khác trong bài.

Dịch câu hỏi:

Tác giả sử dụng điều gì để giải thích thêm cho mỗi luận điểm?

✖ số

✖ ký hiệu

✔ ví dụ

✖ trích dẫn (lời của người khác)

questions.questionText: Which example is NOT mentioned in the text?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

British English and American English are two variations of the English language that share many similarities, but also some notable differences in pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar.

The pronunciation of American English is one of the biggest differences. One of the most noticeable differences is the pronunciation of R. The British tend to pronounce R in the middle and end of words very softly, but Americans like to stress it. Spelling is another difference. Americans often spell many verbs ending with a -t sound by using -ed as in burnt (BE) and burned (AE). In both of these cases, the -t is pronounced. British prefer to spell -ise with a S but American prefer to spell it as it is pronounced with a Z.

There are even differences in vocabulary. Americans use the word “pants” for “trousers” and “apartment” for “flat”.

Grammar is another area of difference. The British are more likely to use formal speech, such as “shall”, while Americans prefer the more informal version, “will”. You may hear the British say “needn’t” but Americans would almost always use “don’t need to”. In spite of these differences, the vast majority of language points are the same in both variations.
questions.hint: Hãy đọc lướt bài đọc và tìm các từ khóa từ mỗi phương án lựa chọn. Phương án nào có từ khóa mà bạn không thể tìm thấy trong bài đọc sẽ là đáp án đúng. Hãy chú ý đến các ví dụ được đưa ra cho mỗi loại khác biệt được liệt kê trong bài.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định thông tin không được đề cập trong bài đọc. Để trả lời, học sinh cần đọc lướt (scan) bài đọc để tìm các từ khóa tương ứng với mỗi phương án và loại trừ những phương án có thông tin xuất hiện trong bài.

Phân tích: Bài đọc đề cập đến những điểm khác biệt giữa tiếng Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ, bao gồm phát âm, chính tả, từ vựng và ngữ pháp. Ta xét từng phương án:

  • Phương án 1 được đề cập trong câu: [[One of the most noticeable differences is the pronunciation of R.]] (Một trong những khác biệt đáng chú ý nhất là cách phát âm của chữ R.)
  • Phương án 3 được đề cập trong câu: [[Americans often spell many verbs ending with a -t sound by using -ed as in burnt (BE) and burned (AE).]] (Người Mỹ thường viết nhiều động từ kết thúc bằng âm -t bằng cách sử dụng -ed như trong từ burnt (Anh-Anh) và burned (Anh-Mỹ).)
  • Phương án 4 được đề cập trong câu: [[Americans use the word]] ... [[“apartment” for “flat”]] (Người Mỹ dùng từ 'apartment' thay cho 'flat'.)
  • Bài đọc không hề đề cập đến sự khác biệt về "fluency" (sự trôi chảy) giữa hai phương ngữ này. Do đó, đây là đáp án đúng.

Dịch câu hỏi:

Ví dụ nào KHÔNG được đề cập trong văn bản?

✖ cách phát âm của chữ R

✔ sự trôi chảy

✖ cách viết của đuôi -ed

✖ từ apartment và flat

questions.hint: Hãy chú ý đến cụm từ "final comment" (bình luận cuối cùng) trong câu hỏi. Điều này gợi ý rằng bạn nên đọc kỹ câu cuối cùng của đoạn văn để tìm ra câu trả lời chính xác.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi này kiểm tra kĩ năng đọc hiểu chi tiết. Để trả lời, học sinh cần xác định vị trí thông tin được hỏi trong bài đọc và tìm ra phương án có nội dung tương ứng.

Phân tích: Câu hỏi hỏi về "final comment" (bình luận cuối cùng) của tác giả. Thông tin này nằm ở câu cuối cùng của đoạn văn: [[In spite of these differences, the vast majority of language points are the same in both variations.]] (Bất chấp những khác biệt này, đại đa số các điểm ngôn ngữ đều giống nhau ở cả hai biến thể.). Phương án 3 là một cách diễn đạt khác của câu này, trong đó "Most" (Hầu hết) tương đương với "the vast majority" (đại đa số).

Các phương án khác đều sai: phương án 1 và 2 mâu thuẫn với thông tin trong bài; phương án 4 là suy diễn không có căn cứ.

Dịch câu hỏi:

Tác giả đưa ra bình luận cuối cùng nào về sự khác biệt giữa tiếng Anh-Anh và tiếng Anh-Mỹ?

✖ Không có sự khác biệt nào về từ vựng và ngữ pháp.

✖ Chỉ có một sự khác biệt nhỏ về cách phát âm.

✔ Hầu hết các điểm ngôn ngữ đều giống nhau.

✖ Sự khác biệt quan trọng hơn sự tương đồng.

questions.hint: Đọc kĩ câu cuối cùng của bài đọc. Từ 'vast' bổ nghĩa cho 'majority' (phần lớn). Hãy suy nghĩ xem tác giả muốn nói phần lớn các điểm ngôn ngữ giống nhau là nhiều hay ít. Sau đó, hãy nhớ rằng câu hỏi yêu cầu bạn tìm từ TRÁI NGHĨA, không phải từ đồng nghĩa.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi này kiểm tra kỹ năng đoán nghĩa của từ trong ngữ cảnh và tìm từ trái nghĩa. Để trả lời, học sinh cần đọc câu chứa từ được hỏi, suy luận nghĩa của từ đó dựa vào các từ xung quanh, sau đó tìm từ có nghĩa trái ngược trong các phương án đã cho.

Phân tích: Câu văn chứa từ được hỏi là [[In spite of these differences, the vast majority of language points are the same in both variations.]] (Bất chấp những khác biệt này, phần lớn các điểm ngôn ngữ đều giống nhau ở cả hai biến thể.) Dựa vào ngữ cảnh, ta thấy từ "vast" (rộng lớn, bao la) được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng 'phần lớn' (majority) các điểm ngôn ngữ giống nhau giữa hai biến thể tiếng Anh là rất nhiều.

Câu hỏi yêu cầu tìm từ TRÁI NGHĨA với "vast". Xét các phương án, "large" (lớn) và "huge" (khổng lồ) là các từ đồng nghĩa, còn "unlimited" (không giới hạn) không phải từ trái nghĩa trực tiếp. Chỉ có "small" (nhỏ) là có nghĩa trái ngược hoàn toàn với "vast". Vì vậy, đây là đáp án chính xác.

Dịch câu hỏi:

Từ "vast" trong đoạn 4 có nghĩa TRÁI NGƯỢC với _____.

✖ lớn

✖ không giới hạn

✖ khổng lồ

✔ nhỏ

We had an exciting chemistry experiment in class last Tuesday. The goal was to create a simple chemical reaction, but things quickly took an unexpected turn. _____.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question below.

When your mobile phone runs out of battery power, all you have to do to get it working again is to charge it up. Imagine if you could do the same thing with your car. Researchers at car companies are developing cars that plug into electric sockets. These vehicles might become the cars of the future.

The cars are called plug-in hybrids and they get most of their power from electricity, just like other electrical devices like mobile phones and laptops. This technology would significantly reduce the amount of petrol that people use. For countries that depend on other oil-producing countries for their petrol supply, this could be a great advantage.

Presently, most cars use petrol. Unfortunately, burning fossil fuels produces carbon dioxide gas, and when a large amount of this gas and other greenhouse gases are trapped in the Earth's atmosphere, they cause global warming. Hybrids vehicles have already been developed and are being driven. These cars get their power from both petrol and electricity; they are able to travel longer distances with less petrol. Plug-in hybrids will be even more advanced as they are designed to be powered mainly by electricity and use only a small amount of petrol. It might be some time before the cars will become available to the public but if they do, it will be a major breakthrough for transport.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi: Nội dung chính của bài viết là gì?

  • Phương án 1: Làm thế nào để phát triển xe hybrid
  • Phương án 2: Xe chạy bằng xăng
  • Phương án 3: Làm thế nào để giảm thiểu xăng
  • Phương án 4: Xe ô tô của tương lai

Thông tin trả lời:

- Đoạn 1, 2 giới thiệu về ô tô chạy bằng điện và những điểm mạnh của nó.

- Đoạn 3 so sánh ô tô thông thường hiện nay và ô tô chạy bằng điện cùng sự phát triển mạnh mẽ của nó trong tương lai.

=> Nội dung chính của bài viết là về ô tô của tương lai.

When your mobile phone runs out of battery power, all you have to do to get it working again is to charge it up. Imagine if you could do the same thing with your car. Researchers at car companies are developing cars that plug into electric sockets. These vehicles might become the cars of the future.

The cars are called plug-in hybrids and they get most of their power from electricity, just like other electrical devices like mobile phones and laptops. This technology would significantly reduce the amount of petrol that people use. For countries that depend on other oil-producing countries for their petrol supply, this could be a great advantage.

Presently, most cars use petrol. Unfortunately, burning fossil fuels produces carbon dioxide gas, and when a large amount of this gas and other greenhouse gases are trapped in the Earth's atmosphere, they cause global warming. Hybrids vehicles have already been developed and are being driven. These cars get their power from both petrol and electricity; they are able to travel longer distances with less petrol. Plug-in hybrids will be even more advanced as they are designed to be powered mainly by electricity and use only a small amount of petrol. It might be some time before the cars will become available to the public but if they do, it will be a major breakthrough for transport.

questions.questionText: The passage mainly focuses on _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the passage then choose the correct answer to each question.

In the 1960s, it took pop and rock groups one or two days to record their songs. Nowadays, it can take months and months. Many rock groups start by recording one instrument, like the voice, and later add other instruments such as electric piano, synthesizer, guitars, and drums.

Next, they might use a computer to add special effects. Finally, they ‘mix’ all the instruments until they get the sound that they want. This means that a CD or cassette will always sound very different from a live concert.

Music engineers have developed a new computer program that will change the future of music. A computer can analyze a singer’s voice. Then if you give the computer the lyrics and music of a song, the computer can ‘sing’ it in that voice. This means that a singer only needs to record one song and the computer can then sing other songs in the singer’s own voice. Singers can sing new songs many years after they have died.

For the record companies, music is a product. When a record company finds a new group (or ‘band’), they first try to develop the band’s ‘profile’. They will try to create an ‘image’ for the band that they think will attract young people. Instead of allowing the band’s full artistic freedom, they will often tell the band what they should wear, what they should say and how they should sing and play.

In recent years, many rock groups have started their own record companies because they say that the big companies are too commercial.

choices.label: C
choices.text: new music genres made by computers

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the best title for the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question.

More than 80% of American high school students do part-time jobs in the evening, on weekends, or in summers. These part-time jobs bring teenagers great advantages.

One of the benefits of the work is the students can learn the skills that will be useful for the rest of their lives. When the students work, they have to manage both the job and schoolwork. To be able to do so, they must be very organized and able to keep a sensible schedule. They also learn to cope with the job stress apart from the stress of the schoolwork. Some of the most stressful jobs include teaching, nursing, and police work. These skills help prepare teenagers for their later careers. High school students who work are more likely to succeed as adults than people who enter the job market at a later age with no work experience. 

Teenagers want a lot of expensive things: clothes, mp3 players, smartphones, etc. Not all parents can afford them. And even if they can, the teens might not really appreciate that money because they did not earn it. When teenagers make money for themselves, they know its true value and are less likely to spend it foolishly.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Advantages and disadvantages of part-time jobs

choices.label: C
choices.text: Disadvantages of part-time jobs to teenagers

questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question.

More than 80% of American high school students do part-time jobs in the evening, on weekends, or in summers. These part-time jobs bring teenagers great advantages.

One of the benefits of the work is the students can learn the skills that will be useful for the rest of their lives. When the students work, they have to manage both the job and schoolwork. To be able to do so, they must be very organized and able to keep a sensible schedule. They also learn to cope with the job stress apart from the stress of the schoolwork. Some of the most stressful jobs include teaching, nursing, and police work. These skills help prepare teenagers for their later careers. High school students who work are more likely to succeed as adults than people who enter the job market at a later age with no work experience. 

Teenagers want a lot of expensive things: clothes, mp3 players, smartphones, etc. Not all parents can afford them. And even if they can, the teens might not really appreciate that money because they did not earn it. When teenagers make money for themselves, they know its true value and are less likely to spend it foolishly.
questions.explanation:
Thanh thiếu niên muốn nhiều thứ đắt tiền: quần áo, máy nghe nhạc mp3, điện thoại thông minh, v.v. Không phải cha mẹ nào cũng có thể mua được. Và ngay cả khi họ có thể, thanh thiếu niên có thể không thực sự trân trọng số tiền đó vì chúng không kiếm được. Khi thanh thiếu niên tự kiếm tiền, chúng biết giá trị thực sự của nó và ít có khả năng tiêu tiền một cách ngu ngốc.

questions.questionText: What is the percentage of students who were laughed at in an unfriendly way?
questions.passageText:
Read the passage and choose the best answer for each question below.

It is often considered that the schoolyard is where bullies go to make other kids a miserable school life, but a new study suggests that classrooms are another popular place. The study, presented recently at the American Public Health Association's yearly meeting in Philadelphia, is based on the results of the research from more than 10,000 middle school students who answered questions online.

According to researched students, 43% said they were physically bullied within the last month. Half of surveyed studentssaid they were laughed at in an unfriendly way, and half reported being called hurtful names. About one-third said groups excluded them to hurt their feelings. 28% said their belongings were taken or broken; 21% said someone threatened to hurt them. According to the results, two-thirds of the students said they were bullied in more than one way over the previous month.

The study authors mentioned that 8% of the students who answered said they missed school at least once during the school year because of fear of being bullied. 25% said they took other actions, such as missing recess, not going to the bathroom or lunch, missing classes, or staying away from some areas of the school to escape from experiencing a bully. Bullies did too much to school life.

  • Phương án 2: 50%
  • Phương án 3: 28%
  • Phương án 4: 21%

Một nửa trong số học sinh được khảo sát nói rằng họ bị cười nhạo một cách thiếu thiện cảm, [...]

Sarah found an old photo album in the attic while she was cleaning. She sat down, flipped through the pages, and smiled at the pictures of her childhood. _____.

a. She realized how quickly time had passed.

b. It’s been years since Sarah thought about those moments, and the album made her feel sentimental.

c. Each photo brought back memories of family vacations, birthday parties, and the time she spent with her friends.

questions.questionText: What is the topic of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question.

Education is another area of social life in which information technology is changing the way we communicate. Today's college students may not simply sit in a lecture or a library to learn about their field. Through their computers and the wonders of virtual reality, they can participate in lifelike simulated experiences. Consider the following scenario of the future of education made possible through developments in information technology.

For children over the age of 10, daily attendance at schools is not compulsory. Yet, some of the older children attend school only once or twice weekly to get tutorial support or instruction from a teacher. For the most part, pupils are encouraged to work online from home. Students must complete a minimum number of study hours per year; however, they may make up these hours by studying at home at times that suit their family schedule. They can log on early or late in the day and even join live classes in other countries. In order to ensure that each student is learning adequately, a computer software will automatically monitor the number of hours a week each student studies online as well as that students' learning materials and assessment activities. Reports will be available for parents and teachers. The software can then identify the best learning activities and conditions for each individual student and generate similar activities. It can also identify areas of weak achievement and produce special programs adjusted to the students' needs.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Information technology has influence on education.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Computer software will make sure students learn at home.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Students can know about their weak aspects to focus.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Students don't have to go to school any more.

questions.explanation:

  • Phương án 1: Công nghệ thông tin có ảnh hưởng đến giáo dục.
  • Phương án 2: Phần mềm máy tính sẽ đảm bảo học sinh học ở nhà.
  • Phương án 3: Học sinh có thể biết được điểm yếu của mình để tập trung.
  • Phương án 4: Học sinh không cần phải đến trường nữa.

Thông tin trả lời:

Nội dung chính của từng đoạn trong bài:

- Đoạn 1: Giới thiệu về việc công nghệ đang thay đổi giáo dục

questions.questionText: What CAN'T the software do?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question.

Education is another area of social life in which information technology is changing the way we communicate. Through their computers and the wonders of virtual reality, they can participate in lifelike simulated experiences. They can log on early or late in the day and even join live classes in other countries. In order to ensure that each student is learning adequately, a computer software will automatically monitor the number of hours a week each student studies online as well as that students' learning materials and assessment activities. Reports will be available for parents and teachers. The software can then identify the best learning activities and conditions for each individual student and generate similar activities. It can also identify areas of weak achievement and produce special programs adjusted to the students' needs.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Find out the best activities for the students

choices.label: C
choices.text: Monitor the amount of time the students spend learning

questions.explanation:
Để trả lời câu hỏi này, bạn cần sử dụng kĩ năng đọc quét (scanning) để tìm thông tin chi tiết không được đề cập trong bài. Dạng câu hỏi "What CAN'T..." yêu cầu bạn tìm ra một phương án mô tả việc mà phần mềm không thể làm, dựa trên thông tin trong bài đọc. Cách làm là lần lượt kiểm tra từng phương án, tìm dẫn chứng trong bài để xác nhận xem phần mềm có thực hiện chức năng đó không. Phương án nào không có dẫn chứng trong bài sẽ là đáp án đúng.

Phân tích: Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định chức năng mà phần mềm được mô tả trong bài KHÔNG thể thực hiện. Chúng ta sẽ xem xét từng phương án dựa vào đoạn văn thứ hai:

  • Phương án 2, "Find out the best activities for the students" (Tìm ra các hoạt động tốt nhất cho học sinh), là một chức năng được đề cập. Bài đọc viết: [[The software can then identify the best learning activities and conditions for each individual student...]] (Phần mềm sau đó có thể xác định các hoạt động và điều kiện học tập tốt nhất cho từng học sinh). Vì vậy, đây không phải là đáp án đúng.
  • Phương án 3, "Monitor the amount of time the students spend learning" (Theo dõi lượng thời gian học sinh bỏ ra để học), cũng là một chức năng được đề cập. Bài đọc viết: [[...a computer software will automatically monitor the number of hours a week each student studies online...]] (...một phần mềm máy tính sẽ tự động theo dõi số giờ mỗi học sinh học trực tuyến mỗi tuần...). Vì vậy, đây không phải là đáp án đúng.
  • Phương án 4, "Identify weaknesses of the students" (Xác định điểm yếu của học sinh), cũng được đề cập. Bài đọc viết: [[It can also identify areas of weak achievement...]] (Nó cũng có thể xác định các lĩnh vực học tập còn yếu kém...). Vì vậy, đây không phải là đáp án đúng.
  • Phương án 1, "Design materials for the students" (Thiết kế tài liệu cho học sinh), là chức năng không được đề cập trong bài. Bài đọc có nói rằng phần mềm có thể "[[generate similar activities]]" (tạo ra các hoạt động tương tự) và "[[produce special programs]]" (tạo ra các chương trình đặc biệt), nhưng việc "tạo ra" các hoạt động/chương trình dựa trên mẫu có sẵn khác với việc "thiết kế" (design) tài liệu học tập hoàn toàn mới từ đầu. Bài đọc không cung cấp thông tin nào cho thấy phần mềm có khả năng này.

Do đó, phương án 1 là câu trả lời chính xác vì đây là điều duy nhất mà phần mềm không được đề cập là có thể làm.

Read and do the following tasks.

In James' small town, everyone knows each other. Last Saturday, the local community organized a clean-up event at the park. _____.

a. After the things they did above, they all felt happy because the town was more beautiful.

b. James and his neighbors gathered to pick up trash.

c. They also planted trees and painted old benches.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: 

Ở thị trấn nhỏ của James, mọi người đều biết nhau. Thứ bảy tuần trước, cộng đồng địa phương đã tổ chức một sự kiện dọn dẹp tại công viên. (b) James và những người hàng xóm của anh đã tụ tập để nhặt rác. (c) Họ cũng trồng cây và sơn lại những chiếc ghế dài cũ. (a) Sau tất cả những việc họ đã làm ở trên, tất cả đều cảm thấy vui vì thị trấn đẹp hơn.

questions.questionText: What is the main topic of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer.

Football, or soccer in the U.S., dates back to 2500 B.C with the Chinese game of tsu chu. The sport we know today originated from Britain. Today, more than 120 million players over the globe participate in the game, making soccer the world's sport.

So, why is soccer so popular? Maybe it's a feeling that the team on the field is your team; their win is your victory, and their loss is your defeat. Or maybe it is the game's international quality. In countries like France, England, Spain, Brazil, major teams have players from many different nations, and these clubs now have fans all over the world. Or perhaps it's the promise of great wealth. A number of professional soccer players, including Cameroon's Samuel Eto'o and Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo, come from poor families. Today, both of these players make millions of euros every year.

However, ultimately, the main reason for its universal appeal may be this: It's a simple game. It can be played anywhere with anything - a ball, a can, or even some bags tied together. And anyone can play it.

In the mid-1800s, European colonists brought the game to Africa. Early matches were first played in the South African cities of Cape Town in 1862. Today, some of the game's best players come from African nations and all over the continent, thousands of soccer academies now recruit boys from poorer cities and towns to play the game. Their dream is to join a national team or one of the big clubs in Europe someday. For some, the dream comes true, but for most, it doesn't.
questions.hint: Để tìm chủ đề chính, hãy đọc kỹ câu hỏi mà tác giả đặt ra ở đầu đoạn 2. Chủ đề chính của bài đọc chính là câu trả lời cho câu hỏi đó.
questions.explanation:
Phân tích: Câu hỏi yêu cầu xác định chủ đề chính của bài đọc. Toàn bộ bài đọc tập trung giải thích lý do tại sao bóng đá lại phổ biến trên toàn thế giới. Tác giả đã trực tiếp đặt câu hỏi ở đầu đoạn 2: [[So, why is soccer so popular?]] (Vậy, tại sao bóng đá lại phổ biến như vậy?) và các đoạn văn sau đó đều đi vào phân tích các nguyên nhân như: cảm giác gắn kết với đội bóng, tính quốc tế, cơ hội làm giàu, và sự đơn giản của trò chơi. Do đó, sự phổ biến của bóng đá là chủ đề chính.

Phương án 2 có thể gây nhầm lẫn vì bài đọc có nhắc đến lịch sử bóng đá, nhưng đây chỉ là thông tin nền ở đoạn đầu tiên, không phải là ý chính được phát triển xuyên suốt bài đọc.

answerFeedbacks.411251: Thông tin này chỉ là một chi tiết hỗ trợ được đề cập trong đoạn cuối cùng, không phải là chủ đề chính của toàn bộ bài đọc.
answerFeedbacks.411252: Lịch sử bóng đá chỉ được nhắc đến ngắn gọn ở đoạn đầu tiên để giới thiệu, không phải là nội dung trọng tâm mà bài đọc thảo luận.
answerFeedbacks.411253: Bài đọc đặt câu hỏi trực tiếp về sự phổ biến của bóng đá và dành phần lớn nội dung để giải thích các lý do cho sự phổ biến đó.
answerFeedbacks.411254: Các câu lạc bộ bóng đá chỉ được đề cập như một ví dụ nhỏ để minh họa cho tính quốc tế của môn thể thao này, không phải chủ đề chính.

Đọc kỹ đoạn 2, ta thấy tác giả có đề cập đến các lý do sau: tinh thần đồng đội (phương án 4) thể hiện qua câu [[Maybe it's a feeling that the team on the field is your team; their win is your victory, and their loss is your defeat.]] (Có lẽ đó là cảm giác rằng đội trên sân là đội của bạn; chiến thắng của họ là chiến thắng của bạn và thất bại của họ là thất bại của bạn.); các cầu thủ nổi tiếng từ nhiều quốc gia (phương án 3) thể hiện qua câu [[major teams have players from many different nations]] (các đội bóng lớn có cầu thủ đến từ nhiều quốc gia khác nhau); và khả năng kiếm được nhiều tiền (phương án 1) thể hiện qua câu [[Or perhaps it’s the promise of great wealth.]] (Hoặc có lẽ đó là lời hứa hẹn về sự giàu có.).

Chỉ có phương án 2 là không được nhắc đến trong đoạn văn. Vì vậy, đây là đáp án đúng.

answerFeedbacks.411259: Thông tin này được đề cập trong đoạn 2 qua cụm từ "the promise of great wealth".
answerFeedbacks.411260: Đây là đáp án đúng vì trong đoạn 2 không có thông tin nào đề cập đến số lượng trận đấu bóng đá được chiếu trên TV.
answerFeedbacks.411261: Thông tin này được đề cập trong đoạn 2 khi tác giả viết rằng các đội bóng lớn có cầu thủ từ nhiều quốc gia khác nhau ("players from many different nations").
answerFeedbacks.411262: Thông tin này được đề cập ngay đầu đoạn 2 qua ý tưởng "the team on the field is your team".

questions.questionText: What does the word “some” in the last sentence of paragraph 4 refer to ?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer.

Football, or soccer in the U.S., dates back to 2500 B.C with the Chinese game of tsu chu. The sport we know today originated from Britain. Today, more than 120 million players over the globe participate in the game, making soccer the world's sport.

So, why is soccer so popular? Maybe it's a feeling that the team on the field is your team; their win is your victory, and their loss is your defeat. Or maybe it is the game's international quality. In countries like France, England, Spain, Brazil, major teams have players from many different nations, and these clubs now have fans all over the world. Or perhaps it's the promise of great wealth. A number of professional soccer players, including Cameroon's Samuel Eto'o and Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo, come from poor families. Today, both of these players make millions of euros every year.

However, ultimately, the main reason for its universal appeal may be this: It's a simple game. It can be played anywhere with anything - a ball, a can, or even some bags tied together. And anyone can play it.

In the mid-1800s, European colonists brought the game to Africa. Early matches were first played in the South African cities of Cape Town in 1862. Today, some of the game's best players come from African nations and all over the continent, thousands of soccer academies now recruit boys from poorer cities and towns to play the game. Their dream is to join a national team or one of the big clubs in Europe someday. For some, the dream comes true, but for most, it doesn't.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi: Từ “some” trong câu cuối của đoạn 4 chỉ điều gì?

  • Phương án 1: các thành phố và thị trấn
  • Phương án 2: những cậu bé đến từ những nơi nghèo khổ
  • Phương án 3: các đội tuyển quốc giá
  • Phương án 4: các câu lạc bộ lớn

Thông tin trả lời:

...trên khắp lục địa, hàng nghìn học viện bóng đá hiện tuyển các cậu bé từ các thành phố và thị trấn nghèo hơn để chơi bóng. Ước mơ của họ là được tham gia một đội tuyển quốc gia hoặc một trong những câu lạc bộ lớn ở châu Âu vào một ngày nào đó. Đối với một số người, giấc mơ trở thành hiện thực, nhưng đối với hầu hết, nó không thành hiện thực.

=> "Some" nói đến "poor boys" (những cậu bé đến từ những nơi nghèo khổ).

questions.passageText:
Read and do the following tasks.

When Anna lives in the city, Anna enjoys the hustle and bustle of everyday life. In the morning, she often visits the crowded markets, where people sell fresh fruits and clothes. _____.

a. However, the noise and traffic can sometimes feel overwhelming.

b. On weekends, Anna escapes to the park to relax and recharge. 

c. In the afternoon, she likes walking through the busy streets and watching people hurry by.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: 

Khi Anna sống ở thành phố, Anna thích sự hối hả và nhộn nhịp của cuộc sống thường ngày. Vào buổi sáng, cô ấy thường đến các khu chợ đông đúc, nơi mọi người bán trái cây tươi và quần áo. (c) Vào buổi chiều, cô ấy thích đi bộ qua những con phố đông đúc và ngắm nhìn mọi người vội vã đi qua. (a) Tuy nhiên, tiếng ồn và giao thông đôi khi có thể khiến bạn cảm thấy quá sức. (b) Vào cuối tuần, Anna trốn đến công viên để thư giãn và nạp lại năng lượng.

questions.questionText: What does the word "this" in paragraph 1 refer to?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question.

If parents bring up a child with the sole aim of turning the child into a genius, they will cause a disaster. According to several scientists, this is one of the biggest mistakes which ambitious parents make. Generally, the child will be only too aware of what his parents expect and will fail.

However, if parents are ambitious in a sensible way, the child may succeed in doing very well - especially if the parents are very supportive of their child.

Michael is very lucky. He is crazy about music, and his parents help him a lot by taking him to concerts and arranging private piano and violin lessons for him. Michael’s mother knows very little about music, but his father plays the trumpet in a large orchestra. However, he never makes Michael enter music competitions if he is unwilling.

Winston, Michael’s friend, however, is not so lucky. Both his parents are successful musicians, and they set too high standards for Winston. They want their son to be as successful as they are and so they enter him for every piano competition held. They are very unhappy when he does not win. Winston is always afraid that he will disappoint his parents and now he always seems quiet and unhappy.

choices.label: B
choices.text: trying to turn the child into a genius

choices.label: D
choices.text: providing the child with music lessons

questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi: Từ "this" trong đoạn 1 chỉ điều gì?

  • Phương án 1: gây ra thiệt hại lớn cho trẻ em
  • Phương án 2: cố gắng biến đứa trẻ thành thiên tài
  • Phương án 3: gây ra nhiều thảm họa nghiêm trọng
  • Phương án 4: cung cấp cho trẻ em các bài học âm nhạc

Thông tin trả lời:

Nếu bố mẹ nuôi dạy một đứa trẻ với mục đích duy nhất là biến đứa trẻ thành thiên tài, họ sẽ gây ra thảm họa. Theo một số nhà khoa học, đây là một trong những sai lầm lớn nhất mà các bậc cha mẹ tham vọng mắc phải.

=> Đại từ "this" thay thế cho "trying to turn the child into a genius".

On Saturday afternoon, Emily decided to spend her leisure time at the park. She brought a book and a blanket and sat down to enjoy the warm weather. _____.

a. While she was walking around the bank, she felt calm and relaxed because the peaceful surroundings helped her forget about the busy week.

(c) Làn gió nhẹ và âm thanh yên tĩnh của thiên nhiên khiến cô cảm thấy rất thư giãn.

questions.questionText: The word "undoubtedly" in paragraph 1 is OPPOSITE in meaning to _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

All over the world, all different cultures created interesting processed meat products, and one of the most popular is undoubtedly sausage.

To begin with, sausage-making may be considered disgusting as it deals with using various animal parts. Since meat is ground up, certain cuts and parts of an animal that wouldn’t be served in their original forms can be used. Literally, this means animal parts such as noses, ears, and other less appetizing areas of an animal’s body. Very often, they ground up meat and flesh is mixed with a certain percentage of fat, along with spices and other fillers. After being mixed well, this meat mixture is then stuffed into the cleaned intestines of the animal, which are then sealed at both ends. The result is sausages.

The meats used in sausages come from a variety of animals, though beef and pork are by far the favorites. In some cultures, sausage made from the meat of horses is considered a delicacy. When sausages are cooked, the cooking process sometimes adds to the flavor. While boiling is probably the simplest method, smoking sausages will add a lot of smoky flavors.

Next time you bite into a sausage, it is probably best not to think too much about how it became the tasty thing you are eating. After all, you don’t want to ruin a good snack.

questions.questionText: What is the best title for the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the passage then choose the best answer to each question.

In the year 1540, Spanish explorers traveled to what today is northern Arizona. There, they found something that amazed them. A wide canyon with steep walls ran for miles through the earth. The explorers tried to climb down to the bottom of the canyon, but it was too far. Later, they reported seeing rocks in the canyon that were bigger than any church tower back in Spain. Today, we are still amazed by this massive geologic formation. We call it the Grand Canyon.

The canyon was created by the Colorado River. The water wears down and carries off the rocks and dirt that it flows over. This action is called erosion. Over millions of years, the river has made a deep path in the earth, and this path is the canyon. Currently, the canyon is more than a mile deep, and the Colorado River still runs along the bottom of it.

People have traveled from all over the world to see the Grand Canyon. Grand Canyon National Park is one of the oldest national parks in America, and more than five million tourists visit it each year. They like thinking about how long it took the Colorado River to carve the canyon. They also enjoy hiking and camping in the canyon. And, of course, they love to stand at the top of the canyon and admire the beautiful views.

choices.text: The Discovery of the Colorado River

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Grand Canyon and American History

questions.questionText: What can be the best title of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question below.

It is not easy for adult students of English to improve their accents. Unlike children, who are flexible, adults often find it hard to change the way they speak. This is why even the top or smartest adult students have difficulty with pronunciation. There are several things that an international student can do to improve his or her pronunciation. 

One method is to sign up for a pronunciation class. Studying pronunciation can help students to understand the rules of English, but in order to practice speaking, students often need to be exposed to English outside the classroom as well. This is why many students say that studying in an English-speaking country greatly affects their English. Living with native speakers can help students to pick up new vocabulary as well as improve their accents. International students can also learn important cultural information. This can help to prevent misunderstandings that can occur when people from different cultures live together.

Living with someone from another culture can be difficult. International students are usually excited when they first show up their new homes, but after a few months, they may start to think about their home countries and get homesick. Students who are homesick get depressed quickly. They might cry a lot or want to be alone. This makes it difficult for them to make friends and learn English.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Problems Adult Students May Face

questions.questionText: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.passageText:
Read the passage then choose the correct answer to each question.

Life in the big city is fast-paced, fun and exciting. There are countless job opportunities and activities to occupy your time. However, with the good, there also comes the bad.

Although the big city has more job opportunities; there are also more people competing for a single job. This can make your job search frustrating. You will see hundreds of jobs available each week, but you still might remain unemployed.

Also, the cost of living is higher in big cities, and a small apartment can be very expensive. Music is a very important part of our lives. Music is for dancing, drinking, eating, loving, and thinking. Some songs remind us of our childhood or youth. Others remind us of the people we love. Many important occasions, like weddings and funerals, have special music. Every nation has a national song like the American “The Star-Spangled Banner”. In the U.S., high school and colleges have school songs, too.

Music is a part of the history of America. It expresses the problems and feelings of its people. As the years pass, the music grows and changes. Modern science has also changed music. Inventions like records, radio, movies, electric instruments, tape recorders and videos have changed the way we play and listen to music. They have helped to make music an important form of international communication.

American music, from the earliest folk songs to modern “pop”, is known around the world. Music is one of America’s most important exports. It brings the people of the world together. Even when people can not understand the same language, they can share the same music. Many people learn and practice English by singing songs. Understanding American music can help you understand American people, their history, and culture.

choices.text: Every nation has a national song.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Everyone in the world shares the same music.

choices.label: D
choices.text: We can practise English by singing songs.

questions.questionText: The word "international" in paragraph 3 is OPPOSITE in meaning to _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question below.

Music is a very important part of our lives. Music is for dancing, drinking, eating, loving, and thinking. Some songs remind us of our childhood or youth. Others remind us of the people we love. Many important occasions, like weddings and funerals, have special music. Every nation has a national song like the American “The Star-Spangled Banner”. In the U.S., high school and colleges have school songs, too.

Music is a part of the history of America. It expresses the problems and feelings of its people. As the years pass, the music grows and changes. Modern science has also changed music. Inventions like records, radio, movies, electric instruments, tape recorders and videos have changed the way we play and listen to music. They have helped to make music an important form of international communication.

American music, from the earliest folk songs to modern “pop”, is known around the world. Music is one of America’s most important exports. It brings the people of the world together. Even when people can not understand the same language, they can share the same music. Many people learn and practice English by singing songs. Understanding American music can help you understand American people, their history, and culture.

questions.questionText: The word "them" in paragraph 1 refers to _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

More American people take their troubles with them on holiday, according to a new survey. Although 40 percent said that the main reason for going away is to escape pressure from work, almost all said they worry more than they do at home. Only four in every 100 said that they are happy and free of care.

The most common worry is burglary, with four out of 10 worrying about their homes being broken into while they’re abroad. More than a quarter fear they will feel crazy with some other noisy and rough holiday-makers and 22 percent worry they may be attacked or their possessions will be missing. One in five think the car may break down, and the same number worry about the chances of bad weather.

The survey also showed that the stay-at-home Americans are no more. Three out of every five want to have a holiday abroad, a great increase from the figures only three years ago. The hotel holiday is still a winner, with about one-third of all Americans preferring to go on a self-catering holiday.
questions.explanation:

  • Phương án 1: người
  • Phương án 2: người Mỹ
  • Phương án 3: áp lực
  • Phương án 4: lý do

Theo một cuộc khảo sát mới, ngày càng có nhiều người Mỹ rước thêm phiền muộn, lo lắng vào họ khi đi nghỉ dưỡng.

=> Đại từ "them" nói tới đối tượng "Americans".

We decided to explore the forest near our house last weekend. Everything seemed peaceful at first. _____.

a. After that, we realized we had lost track of time and started to feel panicked.

b. We set off in the early morning, excited to see the local wildlife.

c. However, the deeper we went, the more we started hearing strange sounds from the bushes.
questions.explanation:
Dịch:

Chúng tôi quyết định khám phá khu rừng gần nhà vào cuối tuần trước. Ban đầu, mọi thứ có vẻ yên bình. (b) Chúng tôi khởi hành vào buổi sáng sớm, hào hứng được nhìn thấy động vật hoang dã tại địa phương. (c) Tuy nhiên, càng đi sâu vào rừng, chúng tôi càng nghe thấy những âm thanh lạ phát ra từ các bụi cây. (a) Sau đó, chúng tôi nhận ra rằng mình đã mất khái niệm về thời gian và bắt đầu cảm thấy hoảng sợ.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question.

Do you ever think about what schools will be like in the future? Many people think that students will study most regular classes such as maths, science and history online.

Students will probably learn these subjects anywhere using a computer. What will happen if students have problems with a subject? They might connect with a teacher through live video conferencing. Expert teachers from learning centres will give students help wherever they live.

Students will still take classes in a school, too. Schools will become places for learning social skills. Teachers will guide students in learning how to work together in getting along with each other. They will help students with group projects both in and out of the classroom.

Volunteer work and working at local businesses will teach students important life skills about the world they live in. This will help students become an important part of their communities.

Some experts say it will take five years for changes to begin in schools. Some say it will take longer. Most people agree, though, that computers will change education the way TVs and telephones changed life for people all over the world years before.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Kids won’t have to go to school in the future.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Computers will change education in the future.

choices.label: C
choices.text: All classes will be taught online in the future.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Teachers will help students from home in the future.

questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi: Nội dung chính của bài viết là gì?

  • Phương án 1: Trẻ em sẽ không phải đến trường trong tương lai.
  • Phương án 2: Tất cả các lớp học sẽ được giảng dạy trực tuyến trong tương lai.
  • Phương án 3: Tất cả các lớp học sẽ được giảng dạy trực tuyến trong tương lai.
  • Phương án 4: Trong tương lai, giáo viên sẽ giúp đỡ học sinh tại nhà.

Thông tin trả lời:

Hầu hết mọi người đều đồng ý rằng máy tính sẽ thay đổi nền giáo dục như cách mà TV và điện thoại đã thay đổi cuộc sống của mọi người trên khắp thế giới những năm trước đây.

=> Nội dung chính của bài viết là: Tất cả các lớp học sẽ được giảng dạy trực tuyến trong tương lai.

  • Phương án 1: Giáo viên từ các trung tâm sẽ giúp đỡ họ thông qua cuộc họp trực tuyến.
  • Phương án 2: Họ sẽ gặp trực tiếp giáo viên của mình để được giúp đỡ giải quyết các vấn đề liên quan đến môn học.

=> Nếu học sinh gặp khó khăn với môn học nào đó, giáo viên từ các trung tâm sẽ giúp đỡ họ thông qua cuộc họp trực tuyến.

Students will still take classes in a school, too. Schools will become places for learning social skills. Teachers will guide students in learning how to work together in getting along with each other. They will help students with group projects both in and out of the classroom.

Volunteer work and working at local businesses will teach students important life skills about the world they live in. This will help students become an important part of their communities.
