The price of holidays can fluctuate a great deal throughout the year, so you can save a lot if you are flexible with your travel dates and avoid peak holiday times. It can be also cheaper if you book well in advance. Before your departure, make sure you get as much information about your destination as you can. Find out if you require any special visas or permits to travel there. Think about spending money as well. Will you be able to access your own money easily enough or will you need to take cash with you? Think about eating larger lunches and smaller evening meals to help your money go further, as lunch is generally cheaper. Make sure that you keep sufficient identification with you at all times. It may also help to email a copy of your passport details to yourself, in case it is lost or stolen. Label your suitcases clearly so that they can be easily identified as yours. It can be useful to store a copy of your itinerary in a prominent place in your suitcase so that the airline will know where to find you if your luggage gets lost. Be sure to pack any medication or other essential items in your hand luggage. If your flight is delayed, or your luggage is lost, these can be difficult to obtain in an airport or foreign country.

Linguists believe that early men used many gestures to communicate with one another. This, it is thought, was man’s first form of communication and the only one he had used for a long period of time. Even today we use some sign language: for example, we shake our head to indicate 'yes' or 'no', we point and we wave, and so on.

The first spoken words may have been early man’s attempt to copy the sounds made by animals. Then he may have developed sounds of his own. Gradually, man may have repeated certain sounds so often that they became familiar and understandable to others. questions.questionText: Which is the best title of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question below.

Trading is a way for people to exchange goods. People have been trading goods since the beginning of time. The way goods are traded has become more convenient as people’s lives have become busier and more complex.

Goods that were hard to find were used to make the first trades. Cows, salt, and tea are some examples. However, as people traveled farther from their homes to trade with others, these goods became difficult to carry and store.

Metal objects were introduced as money as early as 500 B.C. Precious metals such as gold and silver were used to make coins. But carrying a lot of coins was heavy. Paper money was created to be used in larger trades. Coins were still used for smaller trades.

The invention of the computer led to electronic money. Credit cards were first introduced in the mid-twentieth century. Other forms of electronic money include phone cards and gift cards. The wallet phone is the latest form of electronic money. It is a cellphone that can make trades through a wireless connection.

choices.label: B

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Best Kinds of Money to Use

  • Phương án 3: Bò, muối, và trà khó vận chuyển và dự trữ trong các chuyến buôn bán đường dài.
  • Phương án 4: Tiền giấy được sử dụng cho các giao dịch lớn hơn, trong khi tiền xu vẫn được dùng cho các giao dịch nhỏ.

- Phương án 1 KHÔNG đúng với thông tin ở phần highlight thứ 3 "Các vật thể kim loại đã được vào làm tiền tệ từ khoảng năm 500 TCN."

questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question below.

Trading is a way for people to exchange goods. People have been trading goods since the beginning of time. The way goods are traded has become more convenient as people’s lives have become busier and more complex.

Goods that were hard to find were used to make the first trades. Cows, salt, and tea are some examples. However, as people traveled farther from their homes to trade with others, these goods became difficult to carry and store.

Metal objects were introduced as money as early as 500 B.C. Precious metals such as gold and silver were used to make coins. But carrying a lot of coins was heavy. Paper money was created to be used in larger trades. Coins were still used for smaller trades.

The invention of the computer led to electronic money. Credit cards were first introduced in the mid-twentieth century. Other forms of electronic money include phone cards and gift cards. The wallet phone is the latest form of electronic money. It is a cellphone that can make trades through a wireless connection.

questions.questionText: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question below.

Staying in hotels and resorts has been a traditional part of travel since the beginning of mass tourism. But nowadays, many tourists want a more intimate experience. For this reason, they are choosing to 'go native'. This often means staying in the kinds of places that local people inhabit. In big cities, you can try staying with the friend of a friend. You may end up sleeping on the couch or the floor, but the advantages outweigh the discomfort. The biggest plus is that you'll be staying with a local and seeing the city from a local perspective.

Another option is house-swapping. Several websites allow you to connect with people who want to trade living situations. It’s usual to exchange emails about favourite places in the city before the swap, meaning you can have a truly local experience. But of course, you can only do this if you don’t mind having strangers staying in your house.

For the more adventurous, staying in a native structure in an African village or a hut on the water in Vietnam or Thailand can be a real thrill. These might not even include plumbing of electricity, and that is part of the charm. The experience of dealing with oil lamps and carrying water really gives you a sense of how the people live.

No matter how unadventurous you feel, you might want to consider crossing hotels off your list. Getting to know the local way of life is the most valuable part of travel. And what better way is there to do this than staying where the local people actually live?

Câu hỏi: Ý chính của văn bản là gì?

  • Phương án 1: Hoạt động nghỉ lễ mạo hiểm
  • Phương án 2: Những điểm du lịch chính ở Châu Á
  • Phương án 3: Xu hướng lưu trú trong kỳ nghỉ mới
  • Phương án 4: Di sản thế giới

Thông tin trả lời:

Ở trong các khách sạn và khu nghỉ dưỡng đã là phần truyền thống của du lịch kể từ khi du lịch trở nên phổ biến. Nhưng ngày nay, nhiều khách du lịch muốn có một trải nghiệm gần gũi hơn. Vì lý do này, họ chọn 'sống như người bản địa'.

=> Bài viết nói về: Xu hướng lưu trú trong kỳ nghỉ mới

Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

If you walk into the streets and see someone throwing a plastic bottle on the ground, you'll probably get annoyed. But do we react in the same way when we see people throwing rubbish into the sea? We all know how rubbish ruins the environment on land, but we often forget the influence that it can have on environments like the sea, lakes and rivers, too.

First of all, water pollution looks terrible. Many beautiful beaches can become covered in rubbish when whatever we have thrown into the water comes ashore. Even rivers and lakes have some plastic bags and bottles floating in them.

Secondly, rubbish can hurt animals and birds that live in or by the water. If they see a plastic bottle, they may think it is food. However, when they try and eat the bottle, it can get caught in their mouth or stomach and stop them from eating anything else. Plastic bottles can also stop dolphins from breathing. Sometimes, fishing boats leave bits of fishing net behind in the water. Fish can get caught in these and die.

Finally, people forget that plastics contain chemicals that stay in the water. This is very bad for both fish and plants. If you eat fish containing these chemicals, then you can also get ill.

In conclusion, we need to worry about water pollution as much as we care about land or air. We should all protect the seas, lakes and rivers, and remember to take our rubbish away with us.

(Adapted from Empower)

choices.text: Effective ways to reduce plastic packaging

choices.label: C
choices.text: Harmful effects of waste on the aquatic environment

choices.label: D

  • Phương án 3: Những tác hại của rác thải đối với môi trường dưới nước

questions.questionText: The writer raised the question in paragraph 1 to _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

If you walk into the streets and see someone throwing a plastic bottle on the ground, you'll probably get annoyed. But do we react in the same way when we see people throwing rubbish into the sea? We all know how rubbish ruins the environment on land, but we often forget the influence that it can have on environments like the sea, lakes and rivers, too.

First of all, water pollution looks terrible. Many beautiful beaches can become covered in rubbish when whatever we have thrown into the water comes ashore. Even rivers and lakes have some plastic bags and bottles floating in them.

Secondly, rubbish can hurt animals and birds that live in or by the water. If they see a plastic bottle, they may think it is food. However, when they try and eat the bottle, it can get caught in their mouth or stomach and stop them from eating anything else. Plastic bottles can also stop dolphins from breathing. Sometimes, fishing boats leave bits of fishing net behind in the water. Fish can get caught in these and die.

Finally, people forget that plastics contain chemicals that stay in the water. This is very bad for both fish and plants. If you eat fish containing these chemicals, then you can also get ill.

In conclusion, we need to worry about water pollution as much as we care about land or air. We should all protect the seas, lakes and rivers, and remember to take our rubbish away with us.

(Adapted from Empower)

choices.label: B
choices.text: suggest that people tend to overlook water pollution

choices.text: indicate that littering on land is worse than littering in water

questions.questionText: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answers to the questions.

Visitors to London are amazed by the beauty and charm of one of the world’s oldest cities. They enjoy famous places like Big Ben, the Palace of Westminster, and Buckingham Palace. However, visitors seeking a glimpse into the city’s everyday life should not miss Portobello Market, which is the most-visited market in London.

At Portobello Market, visitors can find many different things, such as second-hand items, clothes, jewelry, and vegetables. The most popular section of the market is full of antiques.  Visitors may feel overwhelmed as there are over 1,000 booths manned by antique dealers from throughout England. It’s great fun to browse through antique cameras, watches, pottery and paintings that date back 300 years. Both buyers and sellers look forward to the weekend when they can meet and enjoy the lively atmosphere of the market.

When tired from exploring the market, visitors can drop into the nearby food courts to savour an Indian curry, Italian pizza or sandwiches from Europe. It’s a great pleasure to drink a cappuccino while listening to street performers. These represent the lively fun of Portobello Market, which offers exciting experiences that keep people coming back.

Adapted from “Heritage” – Vietnam Airlines in-flight magazine

questions.questionText: The word "savour" in paragraph 3 mostly means ______.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answers to the questions.

Visitors to London are amazed by the beauty and charm of one of the world’s oldest cities. They enjoy famous places like Big Ben, the Palace of Westminster, and Buckingham Palace. However, visitors seeking a glimpse into the city’s everyday life should not miss Portobello Market, which is the most-visited market in London.

At Portobello Market, visitors can find many different things, such as second-hand items, clothes, jewelry, and vegetables. The most popular section of the market is full of antiques.  Visitors may feel overwhelmed as there are over 1,000 booths manned by antique dealers from throughout England. It’s great fun to browse through antique cameras, watches, pottery and paintings that date back 300 years. Both buyers and sellers look forward to the weekend when they can meet and enjoy the lively atmosphere of the market.

When tired from exploring the market, visitors can drop into the nearby food courts to savour an Indian curry, Italian pizza or sandwiches from Europe. It’s a great pleasure to drink a cappuccino while listening to street performers. These represent the lively fun of Portobello Market, which offers exciting experiences that keep people coming back.

Adapted from “Heritage” – Vietnam Airlines in-flight magazine

questions.questionText: In paragraph 1, the word "gravity" means the force that _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Sleeping in space is unlike sleeping on Earth due to the absence of gravity, which causes the body to float. Astronauts don't need soft beds because their bodies float slightly above them, so it feels like "sleeping on air," which is comfortable. They can sleep in special compartments or use sleeping bags that are attached to the walls. To block out light and noise, astronauts can wear eyeshades and earplugs, which is similar to what some people on Earth do.

Astronauts are scheduled to sleep for eight hours daily, which is the same as most adults on Earth. Astronaut Eileen Collins shares her experience, explaining that astronauts can sleep anywhere in the spacecraft. She prefers sleeping on the mid-deck, close to the stairs, so she can access the flight deck quickly in case of an emergency. Collins finds that sleeping in space is very restful. She explains that without gravity, there are no pressure points, which makes it easy to sleep, as there is no need to switch positions. She finds sleeping in space comfortable and usually sleeps well, though she doesn't always sleep the full eight hours. However, most astronauts don’t sleep as well in space as she does.

choices.label: A
choices.text: powers spaceships as they move through space

choices.label: B
choices.text: enables humans to move in space

choices.label: C
choices.text: allows plants and other living things to grow

choices.label: D
choices.text: causes objects to move to the center of the Earth

questions.hint: Hãy tìm từ "gravity" trong đoạn 1. Đọc kỹ câu chứa từ này và các câu xung quanh để xem tác giả giải thích lực này có tác dụng gì đối với các vật thể (objects) trên Trái Đất so với trong không gian.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi kiểm tra kỹ năng xác định nghĩa của từ vựng trong ngữ cảnh (Reading for Vocabulary). Để trả lời, học sinh cần đọc đoạn văn chứa từ vựng và tìm các gợi ý xung quanh để hiểu nghĩa của từ.

Phân tích: Từ "gravity" (trọng lực) được định nghĩa là lực hút mọi vật về phía Trái Đất. Trong ngữ cảnh của bài đọc [[Sleeping in space is unlike sleeping on Earth due to the absence of gravity, which causes the body to float]], sự thiếu vắng "gravity" là nguyên nhân khiến cơ thể trôi nổi. Phương án 4 mô tả gravity "khiến các vật thể di chuyển về phía tâm Trái Đất" là chính xác nhất.

Dịch câu hỏi:

Trong đoạn 1, từ "gravity" có nghĩa là lực _____.

✖ cung cấp năng lượng cho tàu vũ trụ khi chúng di chuyển trong không gian

✖ cho phép con người di chuyển trong không gian

✖ cho phép thực vật và các sinh vật sống khác phát triển

✔ khiến các vật thể di chuyển về phía tâm Trái Đất

questions.hint: Hãy đọc kỹ đoạn văn đầu tiên. Tác giả đã mô tả vấn đề chính mà các phi hành gia gặp phải khi ngủ trong không gian là gì? Việc gắn túi ngủ vào tường chính là để giải quyết vấn đề đó.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi này kiểm tra kỹ năng nhận diện và suy luận mối quan hệ nguyên nhân - kết quả. Để trả lời đúng, học sinh cần liên kết vấn đề được nêu ra ở đầu bài đọc (trôi nổi do không có trọng lực) với giải pháp được đưa ra sau đó (gắn túi ngủ vào tường).

Phân tích: Đoạn văn mở đầu bằng việc giải thích rằng trong không gian, sự thiếu vắng trọng lực khiến cơ thể trôi nổi: [[the absence of gravity, which causes the body to float]]. Ngay sau đó, bài đọc đề cập đến một trong những cách các phi hành gia ngủ là dùng [[sleeping bags that are attached to the walls]]. Từ đó, ta có thể suy luận rằng việc gắn túi ngủ vào tường là để giải quyết vấn đề trôi nổi, giúp các phi hành gia cố định một chỗ khi ngủ. Do đó, phương án 4 là đáp án chính xác.

Phương án 1 không đúng vì trong môi trường không trọng lực, các phi hành gia trôi nổi chứ không "ngã xuống". Phương án 2 cũng không chính xác; mặc dù bài đọc có nói việc ngủ rất thoải mái, sự thoải mái này đến từ việc không có các điểm áp lực lên cơ thể, chứ không phải do việc túi ngủ được gắn vào tường.

Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

To block out light and noise, astronauts can wear eyeshades and earplugs, which is similar to what some people on Earth do.

Astronauts are scheduled to sleep for eight hours daily, which is the same as most adults on Earth. Astronaut Eileen Collins shares her experience, explaining that astronauts can sleep anywhere in the spacecraft. She prefers sleeping on the mid-deck, close to the stairs, so she can access the flight deck quickly in case of an emergency. Collins finds that sleeping in space is very restful. She explains that without gravity, there are no pressure points, which makes it easy to sleep, as there is no need to switch positions. She finds sleeping in space comfortable and usually sleeps well, though she doesn't always sleep the full eight hours. However, most astronauts don’t sleep as well in space as she does.

questions.hint: Hãy đọc kỹ đoạn văn thứ hai, tìm câu mô tả nơi phi hành gia Eileen Collins thích ngủ. Chú ý vào cụm từ chỉ mục đích "so she can..." ngay sau đó, nó sẽ cho bạn biết lý do chính xác cho sở thích của bà ấy.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi này kiểm tra kỹ năng nhận diện và suy luận mối quan hệ nguyên nhân - kết quả. Để trả lời đúng, học sinh cần xác định được lý do cho sở thích của phi hành gia được nêu trong bài đọc.

Phân tích: Bài đọc nêu rõ sở thích của phi hành gia Eileen Collins: [[She prefers sleeping on the mid-deck, close to the stairs, so she can access the flight deck quickly in case of an emergency.]] (Bà ấy thích ngủ ở tầng giữa, gần cầu thang, để có thể tiếp cận buồng lái nhanh chóng trong trường hợp khẩn cấp.). Câu hỏi "Why...?" (Tại sao...?) hỏi về lý do. Lý do được chỉ ra bởi từ "so" là "she can access the flight deck quickly" (cô ấy có thể tiếp cận buồng lái nhanh chóng). Phương án 3 "Because it allows her to reach the flight deck quickly" (Bởi vì nó cho phép bà ấy đến buồng lái một cách nhanh chóng) diễn đạt lại chính xác nguyên nhân này.

Phương án 1 là một cái bẫy phổ biến; dù cụm từ "in case of an emergency" (trong trường hợp khẩn cấp) có trong bài, nhưng nó giải thích cho việc tại sao cần phải đến buồng lái nhanh chóng, chứ không nói rằng vị trí gần cầu thang là "an toàn nhất".

Dịch câu hỏi:

Tại sao phi hành gia Eileen Collins lại thích ngủ gần cầu thang?

✖ Bởi vì nó được coi là vị trí an toàn nhất trong trường hợp khẩn cấp.

✖ Bởi vì nó thoải mái hơn những chỗ ngủ khác.

✔ Bởi vì nó cho phép bà ấy đến buồng lái một cách nhanh chóng.

✖ Bởi vì nó rộng rãi hơn các khu vực khác.

questions.questionText: What can be inferred from the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Sleeping in space is unlike sleeping on Earth due to the absence of gravity, which causes the body to float. Astronauts don't need soft beds because their bodies float slightly above them, so it feels like "sleeping on air," which is comfortable. They can sleep in special compartments or use sleeping bags that are attached to the walls. To block out light and noise, astronauts can wear eyeshades and earplugs, which is similar to what some people on Earth do.

Astronauts are scheduled to sleep for eight hours daily, which is the same as most adults on Earth. Astronaut Eileen Collins shares her experience, explaining that astronauts can sleep anywhere in the spacecraft. She prefers sleeping on the mid-deck, close to the stairs, so she can access the flight deck quickly in case of an emergency. Collins finds that sleeping in space is very restful. She explains that without gravity, there are no pressure points, which makes it easy to sleep, as there is no need to switch positions. She finds sleeping in space comfortable and usually sleeps well, though she doesn't always sleep the full eight hours. However, most astronauts don’t sleep as well in space as she does.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Eileen Collins always sleeps a full eight hours each day.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Sleeping locations in the spacecraft can be flexible.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Most astronauts feel comfortable sleeping in space.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Astronauts are timed for seven hours of sleep every day.

questions.hint: Để trả lời câu hỏi này, hãy tìm và đọc kĩ đoạn văn mô tả về cách các phi hành gia bố trí chỗ ngủ của mình trong không gian. Chi tiết về chia sẻ của phi hành gia Eileen Collins sẽ là manh mối quan trọng để bạn đưa ra kết luận đúng.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi này kiểm tra kỹ năng suy luận, yêu cầu học sinh phải đọc và liên kết các chi tiết trong bài để rút ra một kết luận không được nêu trực tiếp.

Phân tích: Đoạn văn có câu: [[Astronaut Eileen Collins shares her experience, explaining that astronauts can sleep anywhere in the spacecraft]]. Chi tiết này cho thấy các phi hành gia không bị giới hạn ở một khu vực ngủ cố định, từ đó có thể suy ra rằng vị trí ngủ trên tàu vũ trụ rất linh hoạt. Do đó, phương án 2 là đáp án chính xác.

Phương án 3 có thể gây nhầm lẫn vì bài đọc cho biết Eileen Collins thấy việc ngủ trên tàu rất thoải mái, nhưng câu cuối đã chỉ ra điều ngược lại, rằng "However, most astronauts don’t sleep as well in space as she does".

Dịch câu hỏi:

Có thể suy ra điều gì từ đoạn văn?

✖ Eileen Collins luôn ngủ đủ tám tiếng mỗi ngày.

✔ Vị trí ngủ trong tàu vũ trụ có thể linh hoạt.

✖ Hầu hết các phi hành gia cảm thấy thoải mái khi ngủ trong không gian.

✖ Các phi hành gia được quy định ngủ bảy tiếng mỗi ngày.

questions.questionText: The word "restful" in paragraph 2 is OPPOSITE in meaning to _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Sleeping in space is unlike sleeping on Earth due to the absence of gravity, which causes the body to float. Astronauts are scheduled to sleep for eight hours daily, which is the same as most adults on Earth. Astronaut Eileen Collins shares her experience, explaining that astronauts can sleep anywhere in the spacecraft. She prefers sleeping on the mid-deck, close to the stairs, so she can access the flight deck quickly in case of an emergency. Collins finds that sleeping in space is very restful. She explains that without gravity, there are no pressure points, which makes it easy to sleep, as there is no need to switch positions. questions.hint: Hãy đọc kỹ câu văn chứa từ "restful" và câu giải thích ngay sau đó: "She explains that without gravity, there are no pressure points, which makes it easy to sleep...". Điều này cho thấy "restful" liên quan đến cảm giác thể chất. Hãy tìm từ trái nghĩa mô tả cảm giác thể chất ngược lại.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi này kiểm tra khả năng đoán nghĩa của từ trong ngữ cảnh và tìm từ trái nghĩa. Để trả lời đúng, học sinh cần hiểu nghĩa của từ "restful" dựa vào các gợi ý trong đoạn văn, sau đó chọn từ có nghĩa trái ngược nhất trong các phương án.

Phân tích: Trong bài đọc, tác giả giải thích rằng giấc ngủ trong không gian rất [[restful]] vì [[without gravity, there are no pressure points, which makes it easy to sleep, as there is no need to switch positions]] (không có trọng lực, không có các điểm áp lực, giúp bạn dễ ngủ vì không cần phải thay đổi tư thế). Điều này có nghĩa là "restful" mô tả một trạng thái thư giãn, thoải mái về thể chất, giúp phục hồi năng lượng.

Do đó, từ trái nghĩa phải mô tả một trạng thái gây mệt mỏi, mất năng lượng. "Exhausting" (gây kiệt sức) là từ phù hợp nhất vì nó mô tả một điều gì đó làm bạn rất mệt mỏi, hoàn toàn trái ngược với việc nghỉ ngơi và phục hồi năng lượng.

Phương án "stressful" (gây căng thẳng) cũng là một từ trái nghĩa, nhưng nó thường nói về căng thẳng tinh thần, trong khi ngữ cảnh của bài đọc nhấn mạnh sự thoải mái về thể chất. Do đó, "exhausting" là đáp án chính xác hơn.

Dịch câu hỏi:

Từ "restful" trong đoạn 2 TRÁI NGHĨA với từ _____.

✖ di chuyển

✔ gây kiệt sức

✖ gây căng thẳng

✖ gây đau đớn

questions.questionText: Choose the best way to rearrange the following sentences in order to make a meaningful paragraph.
questions.passageText:
Read and do the following tasks.

We went shopping to prepare for our beach vacation. At first, things didn’t go as smoothly as we had hoped. _____

a. After hours of searching, we found a beautiful one, but it was too expensive.

b. So, we decided to go home and order it online for a better deal.

c. The mall was crowded, and we couldn’t find any swimsuits in our size.
questions.explanation:
Dịch:

Chúng tôi đi mua sắm để chuẩn bị cho kỳ nghỉ ở bãi biển. Ban đầu, mọi việc không diễn ra suôn sẻ như chúng tôi đã hy vọng. (c) Trung tâm thương mại rất đông đúc, và chúng tôi không thể tìm thấy bộ đồ bơi nào có kích cỡ phù hợp. (a) Sau nhiều giờ tìm kiếm, chúng tôi đã tìm thấy một bộ đẹp, nhưng nó quá đắt. (b) Vì vậy, chúng tôi quyết định về nhà và đặt mua nó online để có giá tốt hơn.

Read and do the following tasks.

We went shopping to prepare for our beach vacation. At first, things didn’t go as smoothly as we had hoped. _____

in the end (phr.): cuối cùng thì

then (adv.): sau đó

to begin with (idm.): lúc đầu

after that (phr.): sau đó

Dịch: 

Chúng tôi đi mua sắm để chuẩn bị cho kỳ nghỉ ở bãi biển. Ban đầu, mọi việc không diễn ra suôn sẻ như chúng tôi đã hy vọng. (c) Trung tâm thương mại rất đông đúc, và chúng tôi không thể tìm thấy bộ đồ bơi nào có kích cỡ phù hợp. (a) Sau nhiều giờ tìm kiếm, chúng tôi đã tìm thấy một bộ đẹp, nhưng nó quá đắt. (b) Vì vậy, chúng tôi quyết định về nhà và đặt mua nó online để có giá tốt hơn. Cuối cùng thì chúng tôi đã tìm thấy đúng mẫu đó với giá rẻ hơn trên Shopee.

questions.questionText: According to the passage, some good things about living in the big city are _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Life in a big city is full of energy and offers plenty of job opportunities and exciting activities. However, with the good also comes the bad.

While there are many job opportunities, there is also fierce competition for each position, which can make job searches frustrating. Surprisingly, although there are numerous job listings, unemployment remains a challenge, especially when the economy is down. Another main challenge is the high cost of living. Rent for a small apartment in a decent area is expensive, and daily essentials like food and transportation add to the problem. While cities are lively and exciting, the packed streets and constant traffic can be too much. Traffic congestion has become a nightmare, and it can make you feel irritated. This also contributes to the increase in air pollution. Pollution in the city affects health as it causes breathing issues and other diseases, and can even lead to early death due to long-term exposure to pollutants. Most importantly, crime rates are higher in big cities, and this makes safety a serious concern. You are more likely to face crime in a big city than in a smaller town, which could make you reconsider the idea of living in a big city.

choices.label: A
choices.text: an excellent education system and recreational activities

choices.label: B
choices.text: an excellent education system and job opportunities

choices.label: C
choices.text: a dynamic lifestyle and various job opportunities

choices.label: D
choices.text: a lot of kinds of entertainment and shopping centers

questions.hint: Để trả lời câu hỏi này, bạn hãy đọc kỹ câu đầu tiên của đoạn văn. Câu văn này giới thiệu những điểm tốt của cuộc sống ở thành phố lớn. Sau đó, hãy so sánh thông tin bạn tìm được với các phương án lựa chọn và chú ý đến cách diễn đạt tương đồng (từ đồng nghĩa, paraphrase).
questions.explanation:
Phân tích: Đoạn văn mở đầu bằng câu: [[Life in a big city is full of energy and offers plenty of job opportunities and exciting activities.]] (Cuộc sống ở một thành phố lớn tràn đầy năng lượng và mang lại nhiều cơ hội việc làm cũng như các hoạt động thú vị.). Dựa vào thông tin này, ta thấy:

  • "full of energy" (tràn đầy năng lượng) tương đương với "a dynamic lifestyle" (một lối sống năng động).
  • "plenty of job opportunities" (nhiều cơ hội việc làm) tương đương với "various job opportunities" (nhiều cơ hội việc làm đa dạng).

Do đó, phương án 3 là đáp án chính xác. Các phương án 1, 2, và 4 đều chứa các thông tin không được đề cập trong bài đọc như "an excellent education system" (một hệ thống giáo dục xuất sắc) hay "shopping centers" (các trung tâm mua sắm).

answerFeedbacks.2177342: "an excellent education system" không được đề cập trong bài đọc là một lợi ích của việc sống ở thành phố lớn, mặc dù "recreational activities" có thể liên quan đến "exciting activities" (Đoạn 1).
answerFeedbacks.2177343: "an excellent education system" không được đề cập trong bài đọc là một lợi ích của việc sống ở thành phố lớn, mặc dù "plenty of job opportunities" có được nhắc đến (Đoạn 1).
answerFeedbacks.2177344: Bài đọc nêu rõ thành phố lớn "is full of energy" (tức là lối sống năng động) và "offers plenty of job opportunities" (Đoạn 1).
answerFeedbacks.2177345: "shopping centers" không được đề cập trong bài đọc là một lợi ích của việc sống ở thành phố lớn, mặc dù "exciting activities" có thể bao gồm "entertainment" (Đoạn 1).

questions.questionText: According to the passage, what can happen when traffic congestion increases in a big city?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Life in a big city is full of energy and offers plenty of job opportunities and exciting activities. However, with the good also comes the bad.

While there are many job opportunities, there is also fierce competition for each position, which can make job searches frustrating. Surprisingly, although there are numerous job listings, unemployment remains a challenge, especially when the economy is down. Another main challenge is the high cost of living. Rent for a small apartment in a decent area is expensive, and daily essentials like food and transportation add to the problem. While cities are lively and exciting, the packed streets and constant traffic can be too much. Traffic congestion has become a nightmare, and it can make you feel irritated. This also contributes to the increase in air pollution. Pollution in the city affects health as it causes breathing issues and other diseases, and can even lead to early death due to long-term exposure to pollutants. Most importantly, crime rates are higher in big cities, and this makes safety a serious concern. You are more likely to face crime in a big city than in a smaller town, which could make you reconsider the idea of living in a big city.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The cost of living will go up.

questions.hint: Hãy tìm từ khóa 'traffic congestion' trong bài đọc. Đọc kĩ câu chứa từ khóa này và câu ngay sau đó để xác định những hậu quả mà tác giả đề cập đến.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi yêu cầu tìm thông tin cụ thể trong bài. Để trả lời, học sinh cần xác định vị trí thông tin về "tắc nghẽn giao thông" (traffic congestion) và tìm xem hậu quả của nó được đề cập là gì.

Phân tích: Đoạn văn có đề cập đến vấn đề tắc nghẽn giao thông trong câu: [[Traffic congestion has become a nightmare, and it can make you feel irritated. This also contributes to the increase in air pollution.]] (Tắc nghẽn giao thông đã trở thành một cơn ác mộng, và nó có thể khiến bạn cảm thấy bực bội. Điều này cũng góp phần làm gia tăng ô nhiễm không khí.).

Dựa vào thông tin này, một trong những hậu quả của tắc nghẽn giao thông là làm gia tăng ô nhiễm không khí. Do đó, phương án 1 là đáp án đúng.

Các phương án còn lại cũng là những vấn đề được nhắc đến trong bài, nhưng chúng không phải là hệ quả trực tiếp của việc tắc nghẽn giao thông.

answerFeedbacks.2177350: Bài đọc nêu rõ rằng tắc nghẽn giao thông “This also contributes to the increase in air pollution.” (đoạn 2).
answerFeedbacks.2177351: Bài đọc đề cập chi phí sinh hoạt cao là một thách thức riêng biệt, không liên quan trực tiếp đến việc tắc nghẽn giao thông gia tăng “Another main challenge is the high cost of living.” (đoạn 2).
answerFeedbacks.2177352: Bài đọc cho biết tỷ lệ tội phạm cao ở các thành phố lớn, nhưng không nói rằng nó tăng do tắc nghẽn giao thông “Most importantly, crime rates are higher in big cities” (đoạn 2).
answerFeedbacks.2177353: Việc tìm kiếm việc làm trở nên khó khăn là do cạnh tranh gay gắt, không phải do tắc nghẽn giao thông “fierce competition for each position, which can make job searches frustrating.” (đoạn 2).

questions.questionText: What can be inferred from the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Life in a big city is full of energy and offers plenty of job opportunities and exciting activities. However, with the good also comes the bad.

While there are many job opportunities, there is also fierce competition for each position, which can make job searches frustrating. Surprisingly, although there are numerous job listings, unemployment remains a challenge, especially when the economy is down. Another main challenge is the high cost of living. Rent for a small apartment in a decent area is expensive, and daily essentials like food and transportation add to the problem. While cities are lively and exciting, the packed streets and constant traffic can be too much. Traffic congestion has become a nightmare, and it can make you feel irritated. This also contributes to the increase in air pollution. Pollution in the city affects health as it causes breathing issues and other diseases, and can even lead to early death due to long-term exposure to pollutants. Most importantly, crime rates are higher in big cities, and this makes safety a serious concern. You are more likely to face crime in a big city than in a smaller town, which could make you reconsider the idea of living in a big city.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Air pollution is a major cause of cancer.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Crime rates in big cities will decrease in the near future.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Exposure to pollutants can reduce human lifespan.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Living in a small town can provide complete safety.

questions.hint: Hãy đọc kĩ đoạn văn nói về tác động của ô nhiễm (pollution) đến sức khỏe. Tìm câu mô tả hậu quả nghiêm trọng nhất của việc tiếp xúc lâu dài với chất ô nhiễm. Sau đó, so sánh ý nghĩa của câu đó với các phương án trả lời để tìm ra kết luận logic nhất.
questions.explanation:
Đây là dạng câu hỏi suy luận, yêu cầu học sinh phải dựa vào thông tin trong bài để rút ra kết luận logic không được nêu trực tiếp.

Phân tích: Đoạn văn có đề cập đến tác động của ô nhiễm đối với sức khỏe: [[...and can even lead to early death due to long-term exposure to pollutants.]] (và thậm chí có thể dẫn đến tử vong sớm do tiếp xúc lâu dài với các chất ô nhiễm.). Cụm từ “lead to early death” (dẫn đến tử vong sớm) có nghĩa là làm giảm tuổi thọ. Vì vậy, ta có thể suy ra rằng việc tiếp xúc với các chất ô nhiễm có thể làm giảm tuổi thọ của con người.

Phương án 4 là một lựa chọn gây nhiễu. Bài đọc chỉ nói rằng bạn có nhiều khả năng đối mặt với tội phạm ở thành phố lớn hơn là ở một thị trấn nhỏ hơn ([[You are more likely to face crime in a big city than in a smaller town...]]), chứ không khẳng định rằng sống ở thị trấn nhỏ là an toàn tuyệt đối (“complete safety”).

answerFeedbacks.2177355: Bài đọc chỉ nói ô nhiễm gây "breathing issues and other diseases" và "early death" (đoạn 2), không đề cập ung thư là nguyên nhân chính.
answerFeedbacks.2177356: Bài đọc chỉ nêu thực trạng "crime rates are higher in big cities" (đoạn 2) mà không đưa ra thông tin nào về xu hướng giảm trong tương lai.
answerFeedbacks.2177357: Bài đọc chỉ rõ việc "long-term exposure to pollutants" (đoạn 2) có thể "lead to early death", ngụ ý làm giảm tuổi thọ con người.
answerFeedbacks.2177358: Bài đọc so sánh rằng "You are more likely to face crime in a big city than in a smaller town" (đoạn 2), nhưng không khẳng định thị trấn nhỏ hoàn toàn an toàn.

questions.questionText: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Life in a big city is full of energy and offers plenty of job opportunities and exciting activities. However, with the good also comes the bad.

While there are many job opportunities, there is also fierce competition for each position, which can make job searches frustrating. Surprisingly, although there are numerous job listings, unemployment remains a challenge, especially when the economy is down. Another main challenge is the high cost of living. Rent for a small apartment in a decent area is expensive, and daily essentials like food and transportation add to the problem. While cities are lively and exciting, the packed streets and constant traffic can be too much. Traffic congestion has become a nightmare, and it can make you feel irritated. This also contributes to the increase in air pollution. Pollution in the city affects health as it causes breathing issues and other diseases, and can even lead to early death due to long-term exposure to pollutants. Most importantly, crime rates are higher in big cities, and this makes safety a serious concern. You are more likely to face crime in a big city than in a smaller town, which could make you reconsider the idea of living in a big city.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The job opportunities available in big cities

choices.label: B
choices.text: The challenges and drawbacks of living in big cities

choices.label: C
choices.text: The causes and effects of air pollution in cities

choices.label: D
choices.text: A comparison between living in cities versus small towns

questions.hint: Để tìm ý chính của bài đọc, hãy chú ý đến câu văn thể hiện sự chuyển hướng của tác giả sau khi đề cập đến những mặt tốt của thành phố. Hãy xem xét các ý được trình bày sau câu đó tập trung vào chủ đề gì.
questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi này kiểm tra kĩ năng đọc để tìm ý chính của toàn bộ đoạn văn. Để trả lời đúng, học sinh cần đọc lướt toàn bộ bài đọc, xác định chủ đề chung và các ý chính hỗ trợ cho chủ đề đó, từ đó chọn ra phương án bao quát nhất nội dung bài.

Phân tích: Đoạn văn bắt đầu bằng việc thừa nhận những mặt tích cực của cuộc sống thành thị như cơ hội việc làm và các hoạt động thú vị. Tuy nhiên, ngay sau đó, tác giả chuyển hướng với câu: [[However, with the good also comes the bad.]] (Tuy nhiên, bên cạnh mặt tốt cũng có mặt xấu.). Phần còn lại của bài đọc tập trung liệt kê và phân tích các mặt "xấu" đó, bao gồm: cạnh tranh việc làm khốc liệt, chi phí sinh hoạt cao, tắc nghẽn giao thông, ô nhiễm không khí và tỉ lệ tội phạm cao. Do đó, nội dung chính của bài đọc là về những thách thức và nhược điểm của việc sống ở các thành phố lớn.

Phương án 1 và 3 chỉ là những chi tiết nhỏ được đề cập trong bài, không phải là ý chính. Phương án 4 không chính xác vì bài đọc chủ yếu tập trung vào các vấn đề của thành phố lớn chứ không thực sự so sánh chi tiết với các thị trấn nhỏ.

answerFeedbacks.2177363: Mặc dù bài đọc có đề cập đến cơ hội việc làm ở các thành phố lớn, trọng tâm chính của bài đọc lại nằm ở những khó khăn liên quan đến việc làm và nhiều vấn đề khác.
answerFeedbacks.2177364: Bài đọc tập trung vào việc mô tả các mặt tiêu cực của cuộc sống ở thành phố lớn, bắt đầu từ câu "However, with the good also comes the bad" và sau đó liệt kê chi tiết các thách thức như cạnh tranh việc làm, chi phí sinh hoạt cao, tắc nghẽn giao thông, ô nhiễm và tội phạm.
answerFeedbacks.2177365: Ô nhiễm không khí được đề cập là một trong những thách thức của thành phố, với cụm từ "Pollution in the city affects health...", nhưng đây chỉ là một khía cạnh nhỏ trong số nhiều vấn đề mà bài đọc thảo luận.
answerFeedbacks.2177366: Bài đọc chỉ so sánh ngắn gọn về tỷ lệ tội phạm giữa thành phố lớn và thị trấn nhỏ ("more likely to face crime in a big city than in a smaller town"), chứ không phải là sự so sánh toàn diện về cuộc sống ở hai nơi này.

questions.questionText: This passage is mostly about _____.
questions.passageText:
Read the passage and choose the best answer for each question.

Every year, the average temperature of the Earth's surface gets a little bit warmer. This gradual trend is called global warming. Warmer weather may sound nice, but global warming is something to be very concerned about.

Scientists are worried that continued warmer temperatures could damage the environment in many devastating ways. Rising temperatures might cause plants and animals to become extinct. They could melt enough polar ice to cause the levels of the sea to rise. Weather patterns could also change. There might be more droughts or serious storms with flooding. In some areas, human diseases could spread.

What is causing global warming? Humans are mostly to blame. Pollution from factories and cars adds toxic gases to the air. These gases rise to the Earth's atmosphere. As the sun’s rays warm the Earth, the gases work much like the glass in a greenhouse. They help trap the heat in the atmosphere and make the Earth grow warmer. That is why they are nicknamed “greenhouse gases.”

It is our responsibility to take care of our planet. Global warming is a serious problem with serious consequences. If we want future generations to enjoy their time on Earth, we must act now!

choices.text: the most effective solutions to global warming

choices.label: B
choices.text: the different types of global warming

choices.label: C
choices.text: the reasons why global warming is a serious problem

choices.label: D
choices.text: the causes and effects of global warming

questions.questionText: What could be the best title for the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage then choose the best answer to each question.

A massage is relaxing, and makes you feel great, but did you know that it's also good for you? That's what doctors are now saying. Massage relieves pain and anxiety, eases depression, and speeds up recovery from medical problems.

Research has shown that people of all ages benefit from touch. Premature infants who are held develop faster than those left alone, and healthy babies who get a lot of physical contact cry less and sleep better. Touch can also slow the heart rate, lower blood pressure, and boost serotonin (a brain chemical linked to well-being). It also reduces cortisol (the stress hormone), which makes you more resilient to disease.

Massage also speeds up healing. Bone-marrow transplant patients who were given massages had better neurological function than those who weren't. Furthermore, massage reduced pain by 37% in patients with chronic muscle aches.

Giving someone a massage may be as good as getting one. According to a study by the University of Miami, depressed mothers felt better after massaging their babies, and elderly volunteers who massaged infants felt less anxious and depressed.

Even self-massage works. People with headaches felt better after massaging their temples and neck, and smokers who used self-massage while quitting felt less anxious and smoked less.

=> Tiêu đề phù hợp nhất cho bài đọc là "Những lợi ích bất ngờ của mát-xa".

questions.questionText: The word "prominent" in paragraph 1 is opposite in meaning to _____.
questions.passageText:
Read and choose the correct answer for each question.

In the past, American students did not have to take tests so frequently, and tests did not play such a prominent role in their education. Tests were mainly used to decide where students should be placed in school or what kind of help they needed. Recently, test scores have been published in the newspaper and used as the main way to judge students, teachers, and schools. These scores are used to decide if students pass or fail, where money should be spent, and so on. Tests have recently become a tool for public officials to impose their decisions on schools, and they are enforcing them with great force.

This situation is also unusual when compared to other countries. According to two scholars, "Few countries today give these formal exams to students before the age of sixteen." In the United States, we give standardized tests to children as young as six, even though many experts in early childhood education disagree with this practice. Additionally, few countries rely on multiple-choice tests as heavily as the United States does.

In short, our children are being tested more than ever before in a way that is unmatched in history. Instead of questioning this, many people accept it as normal. As a result, most of today's discourse about education has become very simple, focusing only on raising test scores.

  • Phương án 3: Việc sắp xếp học sinh vào các lớp hoặc chương trình học
  • Phương án 4: Các hoạt động ngoại khóa mà học sinh có thể tham gia

Câu hỏi: Bài đọc gợi ý rằng việc tổ chức các bài kiểm tra chuẩn hóa cho trẻ em từ sáu tuổi là _____.

  • Phương án 1: hữu ích trong việc quyết định một học sinh có nên được lên lớp không
  • Phương án 2: không có lợi cho trẻ em tham gia
  • Phương án 3: quan trọng để đánh giá khả năng học tập của các em
  • Phương án 4: hiếm khi được thực hiện ở các trường học ở Mỹ

Thông tin trả lời:

Theo hai học giả, "Hiện nay, rất ít quốc gia tổ chức các kỳ thi chính thức cho học sinh trước 16 tuổi." Ở Mỹ, trẻ em từ sáu tuổi đã phải làm các bài kiểm tra tiêu chuẩn, mặc dù nhiều chuyên gia giáo dục mầm non không đồng tình với điều này. Ngoài ra, cũng có rất ít quốc gia phụ thuộc vào các bài kiểm tra trắc nghiệm nhiều như Mỹ.

questions.questionText: Which could be the best title of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read and choose the correct answer for each question.

In the past, American students did not have to take tests so frequently, and tests did not play such a prominent role in their education. Tests were mainly used to decide where students should be placed in school or what kind of help they needed. Recently, test scores have been published in the newspaper and used as the main way to judge students, teachers, and schools. These scores are used to decide if students pass or fail, where money should be spent, and so on. Tests have recently become a tool for public officials to impose their decisions on schools, and they are enforcing them with great force.

This situation is also unusual when compared to other countries. According to two scholars, "Few countries today give these formal exams to students before the age of sixteen." In the United States, we give standardized tests to children as young as six, even though many experts in early childhood education disagree with this practice. Additionally, few countries rely on multiple-choice tests as heavily as the United States does.

In short, our children are being tested more than ever before in a way that is unmatched in history. Instead of questioning this, many people accept it as normal. As a result, most of today's discourse about education has become very simple, focusing only on raising test scores.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Future of Tests in America

questions.questionText: What does the first outer circle in the model represent?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

"World Englishes" is a term that describes the different varieties of English spoken globally. To better understand these varieties, we can use the model of concentric circles, which was proposed by linguist Braj Kachru. At the center of this model is standard English, spoken in countries such as the UK and the US. The first outer circle contains countries where English is the second language, like India and Nigeria. The second outer circle includes countries where English is taught as a foreign language, such as China and Brazil. These outer circles reflect the distinct variations of English that have developed over time.

English is now an official language in more than 50 countries, and each of these nations has developed its own version of the language. These versions are not simply copies of British or American English, but instead feature unique vocabulary and phrases. In some cases, English has incorporated words from local languages. For instance, in Singapore, English has borrowed Malay words like "kopi" (coffee), and in India, English includes several terms from Hindi, such as "guru" (teacher).

Immigrants to English-speaking countries often speak both English and their native language. Before they arrive in their new country, many join classes to learn English. Once there, they continue to improve their English skills through interaction with native speakers.

* World Englishes là một thuật ngữ dùng để chỉ sự đa dạng của tiếng Anh trên toàn cầu, vượt ra ngoài tiếng Anh chuẩn Anh-Mỹ, Anh-Anh

choices.text: Countries where English is the first language

choices.label: B
choices.text: Countries where English is the second language

choices.label: C
choices.text: Countries where English is learned as a foreign language

choices.label: D
choices.text: Countries where English is not spoken

Read the following passage and mark the correct answer to each of the questions.

As the second most populous emirate in the United Arab Emirates, Dubai has become a famous tourist destination. In the 1950s, it was a small fishing village. Today, it has become a large, modern city with more than 700,000 people. Dubai offers many things to do for all kinds of visitors. Tourists can enjoy luxury shopping or learn about local culture. They can enjoy a relaxing break and easily discover new and exciting experiences. With great hotels and services, Dubai is also a top place for business events and exhibitions.

Dubai has many exciting things for travelers to try. Visitors can take a desert safari, drive across the sand dunes in a four-wheel drive, watch camel races, or even learn about the ancient art of falcon hunting. They can also try sand skiing. There are many chances to take beautiful photos of old buildings, magnificent palaces, and mosques. Tourists can also visit a Bedouin village to see camels and goats. The desert oases are beautiful, and the sunsets are among the best in the world. Dubai is a heaven for shoppers. Many travel to Dubai specifically for shopping. Visitors can enjoy everything from modern malls to traditional markets. Things are cheaper in Dubai because of low taxes.

choices.label: D

As the second most populous emirate in the United Arab Emirates, Dubai has become a famous tourist destination. In the 1950s, it was a small fishing village. Today, it has become a large, modern city with more than 700,000 people. Dubai offers many things to do for all kinds of visitors. Tourists can enjoy luxury shopping or learn about local culture. They can enjoy a relaxing break and easily discover new and exciting experiences. With great hotels and services, Dubai is also a top place for business events and exhibitions.

Dubai has many exciting things for travelers to try. Visitors can take a desert safari, drive across the sand dunes in a four-wheel drive, watch camel races, or even learn about the ancient art of falcon hunting. They can also try sand skiing. There are many chances to take beautiful photos of old buildings, magnificent palaces, and mosques. Tourists can also visit a Bedouin village to see camels and goats. The desert oases are beautiful, and the sunsets are among the best in the world. Dubai is a heaven for shoppers. Many travel to Dubai specifically for shopping. Visitors can enjoy everything from modern malls to traditional markets. Things are cheaper in Dubai because of low taxes.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because it provides new business opportunities.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because it offers new and exciting holidays.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because it has excellent hotels and facilities.

questions.explanation:
Câu hỏi: Tại sao Dubai là một địa điểm phổ biến cho các hội nghị và triển lãm kinh doanh?

  • Phương án 1: Bởi vì nó mang lại những cơ hội kinh doanh mới.
  • Phương án 2: Bởi vì nó cung cấp những kỳ nghỉ mới lạ và thú vị.
  • Phương án 3: Bởi vì nó có các nghệ sĩ nổi tiếng thế giới.
  • Phương án 4: Bởi vì nó có các khách sạn và cơ sở vật chất tuyệt vời.

Thông tin trả lời:

Với các khách sạn và dịch vụ tuyệt vời, Dubai cũng là địa điểm hàng đầu cho các sự kiện kinh doanh và triển lãm.

=> Dubai là địa điểm nổi tiếng của các hội nghị kinh doanh và triển lãm bởi vì nó có khách sạn và cơ sở vật chất tuyệt vời.

In Tom’s neighborhood, the local community started a garden project. Every Saturday, neighbors gather to plant vegetables and flowers. _____.

a. Last weekend, they planted tomatoes, lettuce, and sunflowers.

b. Tom saw the picture and decided to join them at the next event. 

c. They worked together and took a picture to share on Facebook.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: 

Ở khu phố của Tom, cộng đồng địa phương đã bắt đầu một dự án làm vườn. Mỗi thứ Bảy, những người trong khu vực tụ tập lại để trồng rau và hoa. (a) Cuối tuần trước, họ đã trồng cà chua, rau diếp và hoa hướng dương. (c) Họ đã cùng nhau làm việc và chụp một bức ảnh để chia sẻ trên Facebook. (b) Tom đã nhìn thấy bức ảnh và quyết định tham gia với họ tại buổi tiếp theo.

questions.questionText: What is a food bank?
questions.passageText:
Read the passage and choose the best answer for each question below.

Non-profit organizations that provide food to people who are in need are known as food banks. These organizations are typically run by volunteers who help with sorting and distributing food donations. Volunteering at a food bank is a great way to contribute to the community and assist individuals dealing with food insecurity.

When you volunteer at a food bank, you will be involved in a variety of tasks. A common responsibility is sorting and organizing the food donations. You might also be asked to pack food into boxes for distribution or distribute food directly to those in need. Some food banks also have programs where volunteers cook and prepare meals.

Volunteering at a food bank can be a rewarding experience. It offers the chance to meet new people and have a positive effect on your community. Helping to provide food for those in need can be very fulfilling. Volunteering can also help you learn new skills like working with others, organizing tasks, and solving problems.

In addition to the personal benefits, volunteering at a food bank has a positive impact on the community. By helping to distribute food to those who need it, volunteers contribute to the effort to fight food insecurity. This work can enhance the health and well-being of the people who receive the food. Volunteering also creates a stronger sense of community by bringing people together to work for a common purpose.

choices.label: A
choices.text: A non-profit organization that distributes food to people in need.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A grocery store that sells food at a discounted price.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A restaurant that provides free meals to those who are hungry.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A food delivery service that brings meals to people’s homes.

Emma, a 15-year-old, decided to change her lifestyle for the better. She started exercising every morning to stay fit. _____.

a. Besides exercise, she tried to have a healthier diet by adding more fruits and vegetables to her meals and tried to get enough sleep at night.

b. After a few weeks of changing her lifestyle, she noticed she could focus better in class.

c. She not only did exercise every morning, but she also went jogging after school instead of playing on her phone.

choices.label: A
choices.text: As a result, Emma felt more energized and wanted to tell her friends to change their lifestyles too.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Despite feeling happier, Emma regretted making these changes and returned to her old habits.

choices.label: C
choices.text: On the contrary, Emma felt less healthy and wished she had never made the changes.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Furthermore, Emma found that her focus in class decreased, and she went back to her old habits.

questions.explanation:
as a result (phr.): kết quả là => Phương án 1 là câu kết phù hợp nhất cho câu chuyện.

despite (conj.): mặc dù

on the contrary (phr.): ngược lại

furthermore (adv.): hơn nữa

Dịch:

Emma, ​​15 tuổi, quyết định thay đổi lối sống theo hướng tích cực hơn. Cô ấy bắt đầu tập thể dục mỗi sáng để giữ dáng. (c) Cô ấy không chỉ tập thể dục mỗi sáng mà sau giờ học, cô ấy còn đi chạy bộ thay vì chơi điện thoại. (a) Bên cạnh việc tập thể dục, cô ấy cố gắng có chế độ ăn uống lành mạnh hơn bằng cách thêm nhiều trái cây và rau vào bữa ăn và cố gắng ngủ đủ giấc vào ban đêm. (b) Sau vài tuần thay đổi lối sống, cô ấy nhận thấy mình có thể tập trung tốt hơn trong lớp. Kết quả là, Emma cảm thấy tràn đầy năng lượng hơn và muốn bảo bạn bè mình cũng thay đổi lối sống.

Read and do the following tasks.

Last summer, I went on my first hiking trip with some friends. We planned everything carefully and packed our bags with food and water. _____.

a. After we rested for a while, we continued and when we reached the top of the mountain, the views were worth the effort.

b. At first, the trail was challenging, and we had to slow down because of the heavy rain.

c. However, we kept going until we were halfway through, and we stopped to rest and take pictures of the mountains.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: 

Mùa hè năm ngoái, tôi đã đi bộ đường dài lần đầu tiên với một số người bạn. Chúng tôi đã lên kế hoạch cẩn thận cho mọi thứ và chuẩn bị đồ ăn và nước uống. (b) Lúc đầu, đường mòn khá thử thách và chúng tôi phải đi chậm lại vì trời mưa to. (c) Tuy nhiên, chúng tôi vẫn tiếp tục đi cho đến khi đi được nửa chặng đường, chúng tôi dừng lại để nghỉ ngơi và chụp ảnh những ngọn núi. (a) Sau khi nghỉ ngơi một lúc, chúng tôi tiếp tục và khi lên đến đỉnh núi, quang cảnh thật xứng đáng với công sức bỏ ra.

questions.questionText: What is NOT mentioned in the passage as a source of stress for teenagers?
questions.passageText:
Read and choose the correct answer.

Teenagers face many problems at school, and these problems can affect their health and school results.

One common challenge is dealing with stress and pressure. The demands of schoolwork, extracurricular activities, and social obligations can become too much. This can make teenagers feel very tired or anxious. Another issue is peer pressure. Teenagers often feel the need to fit in and may do risky things to be accepted by their peers. For example, they might try drugs or alcohol, bully others, say unkind things about people, or do dangerous activities.

Bullying is another major concern for many teenagers. Whether it is physical, verbal, or cyberbullying, the effects can be devastating and long-lasting. Victims of bullying often experience low self-esteem and depression, or even think about hurting themselves. Many teens also have trouble with their schoolwork. Some find certain subjects hard or have problems managing their time and staying organized. Others might feel bored because the work is too easy, which makes them lose interest.

Finally, the pressure to succeed and plan for the future can cause a great deal of stress for teenagers. They worry about getting good grades, joining many activities, and building a perfect record to enter a good university.

It's important for parents, teachers, and other adults to understand these problems. They need to give teenagers the help and support needed to handle these difficult times.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Struggling with some subjects at school

Câu hỏi: Điều nào KHÔNG được nêu trong bài đọc là nguồn gây căng thẳng cho thanh thiếu niên?

  • Phương án 1: Việc lên kế hoạch cho tương lai của họ
  • Phương án 2: Giải quyết các vấn đề gia đình
  • Phương án 3: Áp lực từ bạn bè
  • Phương án 4: Gặp khó khăn với một số môn học ở trường

Thông tin trả lời:

- Phương án 1 có thông tin ở phần highlight thứ 3 "Cuối cùng, áp lực phải thành công và lập kế hoạch cho tương lai có thể gây ra rất nhiều căng thẳng cho thanh thiếu niên."

- Phương án 3 có thông tin ở phần highlight thứ nhất "Một vấn đề khác là áp lực từ bạn bè."

- Phương án 4 có thông tin ở phần highlight thứ 2 "Nhiều thanh thiếu niên cũng gặp rắc rối với việc học ở trường. Một số thấy một số môn học khó..."

=> Điều KHÔNG được đề cập là nguồn gây căng thẳng cho thanh thiếu niên là phương án 2 "Giải quyết các vấn đề gia đình".

Câu hỏi: Người viết nói gì về "bắt nạt"?

  • Phương án 1: Việc này chỉ xảy ra với những học sinh có kết quả học tập tốt.
  • Phương án 2: Việc này có thể xuất hiện dưới nhiều hình thức khác nhau và gây ra hậu quả nghiêm trọng.
  • Phương án 3: Việc này là vấn đề phổ biến nhất ở thanh thiếu niên.
  • Phương án 4: Việc này thường xảy ra vào giờ ra chơi hoặc sau giờ học.

Thông tin trả lời:

Bắt nạt là một vấn đề nghiêm trọng khác đối với nhiều thanh thiếu niên. Dù là bắt nạt về thể chất, bắt nạt bằng lời nói hay bắt nạt trên mạng, hậu quả đều có thể rất nặng nề và kéo dài. Nạn nhân của bắt nạt thường bị tổn thương lòng tự trọng, trầm cảm, thậm chí có ý nghĩ tự làm hại bản thân.

=> Theo người viết, việc bắt nạt có thể xảy ra ở nhiều hình thức (thể chất, lời nói, qua mạng) và để lại những hậu quả nặng nề.

Câu hỏi: Theo bài đọc, điều gì có thể khiến một số thanh thiếu niên mất hứng thú với việc học ở trường?

  • Phương án 1: Bài tập về nhà quá nhiều
  • Phương án 2: Mối quan hệ không tốt với giáo viên
  • Phương án 3: Thiếu sự hỗ trợ từ bạn bè
  • Phương án 4: Nhiệm vụ học tập không có thách thức

Thông tin trả lời:

Nhiều thanh thiếu niên gặp khó khăn với việc học. Một số cảm thấy một số môn học quá khó hoặc gặp vấn đề trong việc sắp xếp thời gian và tổ chức học tập. Số khác lại cảm thấy chán nản vì bài tập quá dễ, khiến họ mất hứng thú học hành.

=> Những nhiệm vụ học tập không có tính thách thức có thể khiến thanh thiếu niên không còn hứng thú với việc học ở trường.

  • Phương án 2: Những vấn đề đa dạng mà thanh thiếu niên gặp phải ở trường học

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read and choose the correct answer to the following questions.

As the demand for energy continues to rise worldwide, many nations are now choosing renewable energy sources instead of fossil fuels. Unlike coal and oil, which take millions of years to form and cause major pollution problems, renewable energy is sustainable.

A key benefit of renewable energy is its role in fighting climate change. Using sunlight, wind, and water to create electricity helps reduce the amount of carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere, which is a leading cause of global warming. Additionally, renewable energy can help countries achieve energy security by decreasing the need to import fuel from other countries.

However, there are still some difficulties with using renewable energy. For example, the initial cost of installing solar panels or wind turbines can be high, making it difficult for some regions to invest in these technologies. Besides, since renewable energy production depends on weather conditions, it may not always provide a steady supply in all regions. Still, as technology improves and production costs decrease, renewable energy, which has both benefits and challenges, is becoming more accessible to both developed and developing nations.

In the future, the shift towards renewable energy promises substantial advantages beyond pollution reduction, including promoting economic growth. While fossil fuels will continue to play a role for some time, it is clear that the future of energy lies in sustainability.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Fossil fuels are the main source of energy.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Renewable energy has both benefits and challenges.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Solar and wind power are effective energy sources.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The demand for renewable energy is increasing worldwide.

As the demand for energy continues to rise worldwide, many nations are now choosing renewable energy sources instead of fossil fuels. Unlike coal and oil, which take millions of years to form and cause major pollution problems, renewable energy is sustainable.

A key benefit of renewable energy is its role in fighting climate change. Using sunlight, wind, and water to create electricity helps reduce the amount of carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere, which is a leading cause of global warming. Additionally, renewable energy can help countries achieve energy security by decreasing the need to import fuel from other countries.

However, there are still some difficulties with using renewable energy. For example, the initial cost of installing solar panels or wind turbines can be high, making it difficult for some regions to invest in these technologies. Besides, since renewable energy production depends on weather conditions, it may not always provide a steady supply in all regions. Still, as technology improves and production costs decrease, renewable energy, which has both benefits and challenges, is becoming more accessible to both developed and developing nations.

In the future, the shift towards renewable energy promises substantial advantages beyond pollution reduction, including promoting economic growth. While fossil fuels will continue to play a role for some time, it is clear that the future of energy lies in sustainability.

Read the passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Twenty years ago, people tried to leave the suburbs for cities but nowadays many people are reluctant to make such a move. They say that compared to suburban areas, city life has many drawbacks.

The high cost of living is the first disadvantage. The bigger the city is, the higher the living cost is. Accommodation and petrol are expensive. Food and drinks are also pricey. Apart from that, city people seem to suffer from more noise and air pollution. The densely populated neighbourhoods, busy traffic, and big construction sites make cities noisy and dusty. These are harmful to people’s health, such as increasing their stress levels, disturbing their sleep and making them suffer from breathing problems.

Lack of space is another drawback of city life. House prices are high in the city, so people tend to live in smaller houses or in apartment blocks. Many cities lack spaces for outdoor activities; therefore, teenagers often hang out at shopping malls or in entertainment complexes instead of doing sports outdoors.

The cities’ authorities are trying to overcome these problems. However, they still have a long way to go before they can reduce living costs and pollution, and increase green space to make all cities in the world more liveable places.

choices.text: The reasons for moving to the suburbs

choices.label: C
choices.text: The high cost of living in cities

choices.label: D
choices.text: The causes of pollution in cities

Bài đọc bắt đầu bằng việc nói về xu hướng dịch chuyển từ ngoại ô vào thành phố trong quá khứ, nhưng sau đó nói về sự thay đổi trong xu hướng này và nêu lên những bất lợi của cuộc sống thành phố như chi phí sinh hoạt cao, ô nhiễm, thiếu không gian sống và hoạt động ngoài trời.

=> Bài đọc chủ yếu nói về những bất lợi của cuộc sống thành phố.

questions.questionText: According to the passage, why do teenagers often hang out at shopping malls?
questions.passageText:
Read the passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Twenty years ago, people tried to leave the suburbs for cities but nowadays many people are reluctant to make such a move. They say that compared to suburban areas, city life has many drawbacks.

The high cost of living is the first disadvantage. The bigger the city is, the higher the living cost is. Accommodation and petrol are expensive. Food and drinks are also pricey. Apart from that, city people seem to suffer from more noise and air pollution. The densely populated neighbourhoods, busy traffic, and big construction sites make cities noisy and dusty. These are harmful to people’s health, such as increasing their stress levels, disturbing their sleep and making them suffer from breathing problems.

Lack of space is another drawback of city life. House prices are high in the city, so people tend to live in smaller houses or in apartment blocks. Many cities lack spaces for outdoor activities; therefore, teenagers often hang out at shopping malls or in entertainment complexes instead of doing sports outdoors.

The cities’ authorities are trying to overcome these problems. However, they still have a long way to go before they can reduce living costs and pollution, and increase green space to make all cities in the world more liveable places.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because they prefer them to entertainment complexes.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because they dislike the noise from outdoor construction sites.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because they think shopping malls are the most exciting places.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because there are not many outdoor spaces for them to play.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the best answer to each question below.

Cultural heritage reflects the identity and traditions of a community. It includes historic buildings, traditional customs, languages, and even food that have been passed down through generations. Although modernization has improved economies and technology, it has also put many cultural traditions at risk.

One of the outstanding reasons for preserving cultural heritage is that it helps maintain a sense of identity. Traditions, languages, and historical sites help people feel connected to their past and build stronger communities. Besides, cultural heritage can also bring economic advantages. Many cities attract tourists by promoting their historic sites, festivals, and traditional crafts, which creates jobs and generates income.

However, protecting cultural heritage is not always easy. Restoring historic buildings often costs a lot of money, and some communities struggle to balance modernisation with preservation. Also, as younger people follow global trends, certain customs may gradually disappear.

Despite these challenges, efforts to protect cultural heritage continue worldwide. Governments and organisations are working together to restore historic sites and encourage cultural activities. While societies will keep changing, maintaining cultural heritage is vital for keeping traditions alive for the future.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The role of culture in economic development

choices.label: B
choices.text: The reasons for and challenges of preserving cultural heritage

choices.label: C
choices.text: The impact of modernisation on global traditions

choices.label: D
choices.text: The role of governments in preserving cultural heritage

Choosing a career is an important step for 9th-grade students, as it helps them plan their future and set goals. At this age, many students are unsure about what they want to do. Some may think about careers in popular fields like medicine, law, or engineering, while others may feel drawn to creative paths, such as writing, art, or music. It's helpful to explore different career options to understand their interests and abilities.

One way to do this is by talking to professionals, family members, teachers, or even people online, who work in different fields. Students can learn more about what each job involves, the skills it requires, and the challenges they might face. It's also beneficial to try new activities or hobbies to discover hidden talents and passions.

Additionally, choosing subjects in school that match their career interests can be useful. For example, students interested in science might focus on biology or chemistry, while those considering technology could take computer classes. Making these choices early can give students a strong foundation for future studies.

questions.questionText: What is the main purpose of the text?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage, then choose the correct answer to questions.

As teenagers, setting goals can help you live a more balanced life. Goals give you a sense of direction and help you manage your time better. When you have clear goals, it's easier to focus on schoolwork, hobbies, and time with friends and family.

To start, think about what is important to you. For example, you may want to improve your grades, learn a new sport, or spend more time with family. Once you know your goal, break it into smaller steps. This makes it easier to work on and helps you stay motivated to try harder.

It's also important to set goals that you can achieve. If your goal is too hard, you might feel frustrated and give up. For example, if you want to get fit, start by jogging a few times a week instead of trying to run a marathon.

Finally, check your progress often. Ask yourself if you are still on track to reach your goal. If not, change your plan and try again. This will help you stay focused and not lose motivation. 

By setting your own goals, you can create a balanced and happy life, making sure there is time for everything that matters to you.

choices.text: To show why teenagers should focus more on their hobbies.

choices.label: B
choices.text: To encourage teenagers to spend more time with family.

choices.label: C
choices.text: To describe how teenagers can achieve school success easily.

choices.label: D
choices.text: To explain how setting goals can lead to a more balanced life.

questions.questionText: Which statement is NOT true according to the text?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage, then choose the correct answer to questions.

As teenagers, setting goals can help you live a more balanced life. Goals give you a sense of direction and help you manage your time better. When you have clear goals, it's easier to focus on schoolwork, hobbies, and time with friends and family.

To start, think about what is important to you. For example, you may want to improve your grades, learn a new sport, or spend more time with family. Once you know your goal, break it into smaller steps. This makes it easier to work on and helps you stay motivated to try harder.

It's also important to set goals that you can achieve. If your goal is too hard, you might feel frustrated and give up. For example, if you want to get fit, start by jogging a few times a week instead of trying to run a marathon.

Finally, check your progress often. Ask yourself if you are still on track to reach your goal. If not, change your plan and try again. This will help you stay focused and not lose motivation. 

By setting your own goals, you can create a balanced and happy life, making sure there is time for everything that matters to you.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the reading passage?
questions.passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

The Trang An Grottoes are located in Ninh Bình Province in the southern part of the Red River Delta. The area includes 50 small attractive caves formed by water. They cover an area of 31 valleys, which is home to 600 types of plants and 200 kinds of animals. The unique environment is now attracting visitors who come to admire the splendid scenery.

Visitors will notice limestone peaks, or mountain tops, and vertical cliffs that seem to grow out of the edge of the water. This has led some tourists to call it 'Ha Long Bay on land'. People have lived in this area for over 30,000 years. It was also home to the ancient Vietnamese capital, Hoa Lu, in the 10th-11th centuries AD.

Most visitors rent small boats with guides at affordable prices to take them to the best places in the area. There are some nearby hotels run by friendly hotel staff. Today the area contains pagodas, villages, paddy fields, and temples and is considered by visitors as an amazing tourist attraction.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Trang An used to be the ancient Vietnamese capital.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Trang An has small attractive caves formed by water.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Visitors must take a boat ride when visiting Trang An.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Trang An is considered as an amazing tourist destination.

  • Phương án 1: Tràng An từng là kinh đô cổ của Việt Nam.
  • Phương án 2: Tràng An có những hang động nhỏ đẹp thu hút được tạo thành từ nước.
  • Phương án 3: Du khách phải đi thuyền khi đến thăm Tràng An.
  • Phương án 4: Tràng An được coi là một điểm du lịch tuyệt vời.

Thông tin trả lời:

Nội dung chính của từng đoạn văn:

- Đoạn 1: Giới thiệu vị trí địa lý và đặc điểm tự nhiên của Quần thể hang động Tràng An.

- Đoạn 2: Nói về đặc điểm địa hình và giá trị lịch sử của Quần thể hang động Tràng An.

- Đoạn 3: Nói về trải nghiệm du lịch và cơ sở hạ tầng của Quần thể hang động Tràng An.

=> Văn bản giới thiệu Tràng An như một điểm du lịch hấp dẫn với giá trị độc đáo về cảnh quan thiên nhiên, đa dạng sinh học và di sản lịch sử văn hóa lâu đời, thu hút nhiều du khách đến tham quan và trải nghiệm.

=> Văn bản chủ yếu bàn về: Tràng An được coi là một điểm du lịch tuyệt vời.
